She's alone without a coat, phone or medication for her epilepsy and in a state of high distress. After making several emergency calls to police, Gaia's family believe that a widespread search for her is underway. (Documentary, Crime, Miniseries) - 2023

Despite multiple warnings from those closest to her, Gaia wanted to help him and they became close. (Documentary, Crime, Miniseries) - 2023

bbc3.uk.title: Gaia: A Death on Dancing Ledge
bbc3.uk.description: Zara McDermott discovers that Gaia's alleged attacker contacted her ten months before she went missing. bbc3.uk.title: Stacey Dooley - Meet the Shoplifters
bbc3.uk.description: In Britain the shoplifting is at an all-time high, incidents of violence and abuse against shop staff have skyrocketed, and a third of Brits have admitted to stealing through the self-checkouts. To understand what's causing this high-street epidemic, Stacey is meeting the people behind the crime and spending time on the shop floor with the staff who deal with shoplifting every day. In Manchester city centre, beauty and cosmetics chain Bodycare has one of its biggest and most shoplifted stores. (Documentary, Public affairs) - 2025

bbc3.uk.title: Stacey Dooley - Growing Up Gypsy
bbc3.uk.description: Stacey heads to Bedfordshire to the private site where 23-year-old Chantelle lives with her husband, Swayley. Chantelle prides herself in keeping with the old Gypsy values her granny Rita taught her and sharing them on social media. (Documentary, Public affairs) - 2025

bbc3.uk.title: Cunk on Earth - The Renaissance Will Not Be Televised
bbc3.uk.description: Continuing her journey through mankind's journey, Cunk visits the allegedly beautiful city of Florence to explore the Renaissance, and she interrogates experts and historians about the revolutions that went on to shape the modern world, including the American War of Independence, and to a lesser extent, the French Revolution. (Comedy) - 2022

bbc3.uk.title: Cunk on Earth - Rise of the Machines
bbc3.uk.description: Cunk continues her ambitious march across the face of mankind into an age of industry and science. With the help of historians, and a science-historian, she explains the scientific breakthroughs of Marie Curie and Albert Einstein. She demonstrates the inventions that changed the world, and covers how the US Civil War, World War I and World War II taught humanity how to use its new grasp of technology to shoot, blow up and irradiate itself in huge numbers. (Comedy) - 2022

bbc3.uk.title: Cunk on Earth - War(s) of the World(s)
bbc3.uk.description: Cunk travels the world and meets top experts to examine the Cold War, the Space Race, Globalisation and Social Media. Recent history is one of polarisation and division as humanity divided itself down the middle: Communism vs Capitalism, Apple vs Microsoft, Beatles vs Stones. (Comedy) - 2022

highstreettv5.uk.description: Fun And Midway Games. At Woodlands Castle, Drew falls in love with vintage toys. In Lincolnshire, he visits a reclamation yard that buys low and sells even lower.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: The Dirt Dogs are determined to get the gold-tally up after last year's devastating season. Meanwhile, the Scrappers are stuck building their machine leaving them behind schedule.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: The Dirt Dogs are under more pressure when their plant doesn't deliver the gold they're expecting. Meanwhile, the Scrappers are in trouble before they've even started mining.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Outback Opal Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Against All Odds. Rookie Justin struggles to get his 20-tonne excavator across an extremely busy highway. Plus, Opal Queen Kelly tackles a new challenge with a new partner.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Outback Opal Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Blue Fire Opal Or Bust. Justin recruits his fiancé after admitting he's facing financial disaster. Plus, the Fire Crew face deadly snakes and the Cooke Brothers go down deep.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Hungarian Special. Drew and Tee take a road trip in Hungary. In Budapest, they visit one of the country's biggest antique markets. Later, they unearth treasures in a former communist factory.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried: Classic Cars
highstreettv5.uk.description: Mini Clubman. Henry and Fuzz find a Mini Clubman racing car in Surrey. Can they get this track legend back to winning ways, or will it stay at the back of the pack.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried
highstreettv5.uk.description: Taff / Chopper. Henry and Fuzz motor over to Taff's place in Lincoln. His extensive collection of Easy Rider-style chopper motorbikes includes an engraved 1970s Yamaha.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried
highstreettv5.uk.description: Peter And Cat / RAF Truck. Henry and Fuzz view an exquisite collection of military and civilian vehicles in Guildford. What will they sell to the drummer from a British rock band.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
highstreettv5.uk.description: Henry and Simon head to Melton Mowbray in Leicestershire. They search through an old windmill filled with old tools, including a classic drill and parts of the mill itself.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Celebrity Yorkshire Auction House
highstreettv5.uk.description: Angus visits Debbie McGee and finds a treasure trove of magical items, but what is she willing to sell? And Rav Wilding is keen to sell some family heirlooms.

highstreettv5.uk.title: The Yorkshire Auction House
highstreettv5.uk.description: Angus heads to Bradford to look through a vast collection of coins, toys and jewellery. Plus, the team clear Yorkshire-made furniture from a beautiful cottage.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Antiques Road Trip
highstreettv5.uk.description: The Sacred Art Of Brewing. Slick dealer Danny Sebastian and auctioneer queen Irita Marriott head to Suffolk. They nab a cider flagon and sad-looking dog statue.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried
highstreettv5.uk.description: Martin. Henry and Fuzz visit Martin in Ipswich. Henry has his eye on a vintage Land Rover and Fuzz finds a miniature scooter, but what will Martin part with.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried
highstreettv5.uk.description: Roger. Henry and Fuzz explore Roger's garage of buses in Coventry. For former mechanic Fuzz, it's a busman's holiday, for Henry, it's a voyage of discovery.

highstreettv5.uk.title: New: Aussie Gold Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: The Poseidon Crew chase a dream hunting for gold in the mountains of Tasmania. Shane calls in a lifelong friend to help secure the sale of his lease.

amc.us.title: Freddy vs. Jason
amc.us.description: Two horror icons face off in this supernatural movie. Disfigured serial killer Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), who attacks his victims in their dreams, has lost much of his power since citizens of his town have become less afraid of him. Enlisting the help of fellow violent murderer Jason Voorhees (Ken Kirzinger), Freddy orchestrates a new killing spree. However, when the hockey-mask-wearing psychopath won't stop chopping up Freddy's intended victims, the two ghouls start to battle each other. (Horror) - 2003

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
amc.us.description: In Wes Craven's classic slasher film, several Midwestern teenagers fall prey to Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), a disfigured midnight mangler who preys on the teenagers in their dreams -- which, in turn, kills them in reality. After investigating the phenomenon, Nancy (Heather Langenkamp) begins to suspect that a dark secret kept by her and her friends' parents may be the key to unraveling the mystery, but can Nancy and her boyfriend Glen (Johnny Depp) solve the puzzle before it's too late? (Horror, Thriller) - 1984

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
amc.us.description: Jesse Walsh (Mark Patton) moves with his family into the home of the lone survivor from a series of attacks by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). There, Jesse is bedeviled by nightmares and inexplicably violent impulses. It turns out Freddy needs a host body to carry out his gruesome vendetta against the youth of Springwood, Ohio. While Freddy gains influence, Jesse and his girlfriend, Lisa (Kim Myers), race against the clock trying to figure out what's going on. (Horror) - 1985

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
amc.us.description: During a hallucinatory incident, young Kristen Parker (Patricia Arquette) has her wrists slashed by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). Her mother, mistaking the wounds for a suicide attempt, sends Kristen to a psychiatric ward, where she joins a group of similarly troubled teens. One of the doctors there is Nancy Thompson (Heather Langenkamp), who had battled Freddy some years before. Nancy senses a potential in Kristen to rid the world of Freddy once and for all. (Horror) - 1987

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
amc.us.description: Teenagers Nancy, Quentin, Kris, Jesse and Dean are all neighborhood friends who begin having the same dream of a horribly disfigured man who wears a tattered sweater and a glove made of knives. The man, Freddy Krueger (Jackie Earle Haley), terrorizes them in their dreams, and the only escape is to wake up. But when one of their number dies violently, the friends realize that what happens in the dream world is real, and the only way to stay alive is to stay awake. (Horror) - 2010

amc.us.title: The Conjuring
amc.us.description: In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history. (Horror, Thriller) - 2013

amc.us.title: The Crazies
amc.us.description: Anarchy reigns when an unknown toxin turns the peaceful citizens of Ogden Marsh into bloodthirsty lunatics. In an effort to contain the spread of the infection, authorities blockade the town and use deadly force to keep anyone from getting in or out. Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutton and his wife and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

amc.us.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
amc.us.description: After his son is set upon by a scarecrow that seems to have come alive, farmer Jack Taggart Sr. (Ray Wise) and his son, Jack Taggart Jr. (Luke Edwards), go looking for an explanation. Meanwhile, a bus carrying high-school students breaks down nearby, and a creature known as the Creeper (Jonathan Breck) starts a killing spree. The elder Taggart soon realizes that the killings and the attack on his son are connected, and, after alerting the community to be on guard, he aims to pummel the Creeper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

amc.us.title: Jeepers Creepers
amc.us.description: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of an old abandoned church, Trish (Gina Philips) and her brother Darry (Justin Long) watch their routine road trip home from college turn into a heart-stopping race for their lives. They find themselves the chosen prey of an indestructible force that relentlessly pursues them and gives a new and chilling meaning to the old song "Jeepers Creepers." (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2001

amc.us.title: House of Wax
amc.us.description: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum. (Horror) - 2005

amc.us.title: Final Destination
amc.us.description: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

amc.us.title: Final Destination 2
amc.us.description: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

comedydynamics.us.description: Greg Fitzsimmons discusses the joys of life as a baby; how to get a man to do anything you want; an explanation of how we flaunt our good fortune as a nation through water parks.

comedydynamics.us.title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
comedydynamics.us.description: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

comedydynamics.us.title: Gina Brillon: Pacifically Speaking
comedydynamics.us.description: Comic Gina Brillon performs.

comedydynamics.us.title: Whitney Cummings: Money Shot
comedydynamics.us.description: One of the funniest comics on television.

comedydynamics.us.title: Arnez J: Racially Motivated
comedydynamics.us.description: A comedy performance by Arnez J at Boston's Wilbur Theater.

comedydynamics.us.title: Tom Papa: Human Mule
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedian Tom Papa returns to Cleveland while relating the everyman struggles of family life, falling behind to the super rich and his hilarious cure for angry young men.

comedydynamics.us.title: SXSW Comedy With Natasha Leggero
comedydynamics.us.description: Stand-up performances include Baron Vaughn, Andrew Santino, Emily Heller, James Adomian and Moshe Kasher; Natasha Leggero hosts; the SXSW festival in Austin, Texas.

comedydynamics.us.title: SXSW Comedy With Natasha Leggero Part 2
comedydynamics.us.description: The performing comics include Emo Phillips, Sean Patton, Ian Edwards, Kurt Braunohler and Eliza Skinner.

comedydynamics.us.title: Andrew Schiavone: Central Nervousness
comedydynamics.us.description: From growing up in Northern Virginia to feeling unsafe in his new home in New York, Andrew's charming world view shines through in stories about dating, workplace mishaps and first loves.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bob Saget: Zero to Sixty
comedydynamics.us.description: Bob Saget declares himself to be the last TV father viewers can trust in his hour of entertaining stories, riffing with the audience, words of wisdom and new original comedy songs.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bob Saget: That's What I'm Talkin' About
comedydynamics.us.description: Bob Saget takes to the stage with a filthy song in his heart as he lets loose and embraces the dark side as he tells his favorite dirty jokes and stories about his dad - the guy who made him like this.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
comedydynamics.us.description: A live concert performance that leans heavily on four favorite characters; cranky old man Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, the mischievous purple whatsit and Peanut.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
comedydynamics.us.description: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

comedydynamics.us.title: Anjelah Johnson: Mahalo & Goodnight
comedydynamics.us.description: Filmed at the Hawaii Theater in Honolulu, Hawaii, Anjelah Johnson's fourth stand-up comedy special dishes on awkward massages, home invasions, spiders and being a full-grown child.

comedydynamics.us.title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
comedydynamics.us.description: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

comedydynamics.us.title: Gina Brillon: The Floor Is Lava
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic pulls no punches when discussing her childhood, culture and the transition from single to married life with her Midwestern husband.

comedydynamics.us.title: Ilana Glazer: The Planet Is Burning
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic shares her thoughts on homophobes, Nazis, women's razors, and what a joke the patriarchy is.

comedydynamics.us.title: Richard Jeni: Platypus Man
comedydynamics.us.description: The Brooklyn-born comedian performs.

comedydynamics.us.title: Tom Wilson: Bigger Than You
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedian Tom Wilson shares his viewpoints on life with observations and musical numbers.

comedydynamics.us.title: Tom Segura: Completely Normal
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedian Tom Segura opens up about hotels, his hobbies and digestive ailments.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
comedydynamics.us.description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
comedydynamics.us.description: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bill Hicks: Reflections
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedy Dynamics sits down with Bill Hicks' brother, Steve, who tells old stories, squashes old rumors and reveals the brother and son behind the late comedian. Told amidst old and rare footage of Bill.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bill Hicks: One Night Stand
comedydynamics.us.description: Bill Hicks offers his unique take on smoking cigarettes, smoking pot, drinking, sex, advertising and music.

comedydynamics.us.title: Eddie Griffin: Undeniable
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic celebrates a 30-year anniversary in comedy by discussing the world, relationships and humanity.

comedydynamics.us.title: Eddie Griffin: You Can Tell Em I Said It
comedydynamics.us.description: Eddie shares his thoughts on his love for Michelle Obama, God's sense of humor, who really makes up the Tea Party, and why Cleveland should get over LeBron James.

comedydynamics.us.title: Tahir Moore: Aging Out
comedydynamics.us.description: Tahir Moore brings high-energy, no-filter comedy in a wild ride through the zombie apocalypse, fancy toilets, naps, and aging; self-roasting, brutally honest, and always hilarious-this is stand-up with zero chill, big laughs, and all heart.

comedydynamics.us.title: Tim Allen: Men Are Pigs
comedydynamics.us.description: The comedian examines man's obsession with hardware at the State Theater in Kalamazoo, Mich.

comedydynamics.us.title: Tim Allen Rewires America
comedydynamics.us.description: The comedian performs in Ann Arbor, Mich.

comedydynamics.us.title: Sam Tallent: Waiting for Death to Claim Us
comedydynamics.us.description: Follows stand-up scion Sam Tallent through 13 different venues across the US from sold-out theaters to house parties and rib-joints, all the while COVID barrels down on the nation in early 2020.

comedydynamics.us.title: Margaret Cho: psyCHO
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic tackles off-limits issues including Boko Haram, racism and her own sexuality.

comedydynamics.us.title: Kevin Smith: Silent But Deadly Extended Edition
comedydynamics.us.description: Kevin Smith is anything but quiet in this new comedy special that was recorded an hour before his heart attack in February; before he nearly died backstage, onstage he discusses his marriage, his kid and his work (or lack thereof).

comedydynamics.us.title: Lavell Crawford I Could Eat Part 2
comedydynamics.us.description: Meat's on the menu with Lavell Crawford keeping Burger King humble to their have it your way slogan, godless vegetarians, and why the best chicken is from a house of God.

comedydynamics.us.title: Denise Winkelman: Bougie on a Budget
comedydynamics.us.description: Denise Winkelman mixes sharp wit and heartfelt humor as she shares her journey from a small town with hick parents to life as a transgender woman in Los Angeles, turning struggles into comedy.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Garcia: Low Budget Madness
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic performs.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Garcia: Livin The Dream
comedydynamics.us.description: Famed Latino comedian and voiceover artist Jeff Garcia performs his signature improv style at San Manuel Indian Bingo and Casino. He comments on his family, unreliable cars, white people, marriage and his run-ins with the law.

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02

own.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
own.us.description: S07 E14 League City Limits A Texas couple's $1 million win is the perfect chance to ditch their small home; they call on David Bromstad to find their League City, Texas dream home that has plenty of space for their teenagers.

own.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
own.us.description: S07 E05 Fort Worth Fortune A professional poker player and his family are looking for their ultimate dream home in Fort Worth, Texas; David Bromstad's expertise is needed to find a place big enough to fit dad, mom and their three small children.

own.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
own.us.description: S07 E12 Mass Cash Stash A couple in Orange, Mass., struggles to make ends meet until she wins $4 million from the lottery and changes their lives; David Bromstad helps them find a home with lots of square footage and a big backyard for their dog.

own.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
own.us.description: S02 E04 Lucky in Louisville Todd bought a lottery ticket on the way home from his daughter's baby shower, and now can provide a home to raise her near family and friends.

own.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
own.us.description: S07 E06 Winning Big in Florida A man who won big is ready to buy a new home in Cape Coral, Fla., with his wife; they look to David Bromstad for his real estate expertise; David finds potential properties with reasonable price tags and breathtaking scenic waterways.

own.us.title: Love It or List It
own.us.description: S08 E10 Make Room for Two More A couple with plans to have a second child end up expecting twins.

own.us.title: Love It or List It
own.us.description: S08 E13 Handyman Husband Re-inventing a tight basement to provide more space.

own.us.title: Hoarding: Buried Alive
own.us.description: S01 E05 Family Secrets Two women seek help for their compulsive hoarding problems.

own.us.title: Hoarding: Buried Alive
own.us.description: S01 E04 Life on Fire Wanda and Ray are extreme hoarders who face losing their homes and living in isolation if they don't stop surrounding themselves with stuff; filled with anguish, Wanda and Ray know that time is running out.

own.us.title: Hoarding: Buried Alive
own.us.description: S07 E08 My Teeth Are Lost in the Pile A wife has transformed one couple's home into a heap of trash; on the verge of foreclosure.

own.us.title: Hot Bench
own.us.description: S07 E82 Drastic COVID-Fighting Tactics!; Bad Driver Blames Police?! A tenant's fear of contagion from his landlord leads to bolting himself inside; an uninsured, unlicensed driver says the police got it wrong when they charged her with driving unsafely after reportedly causing an accident.

own.us.title: Hot Bench
own.us.description: S07 E92 Indecent Proposal at the Casino?; Judge DiMango Feels Your Pain! A man gives a woman money on their first date, but she says it turned into a loan because she wouldn't sleep with him; a judge empathizes with a woman who invested $20,000 in a home remodel and was left with unfinished work and a missing contractor.

own.us.title: Hot Bench
own.us.description: S07 E96 Mistaken Identity Violence! A tragic set of coincidences leads to an innocent man being brutally beaten in a parking lot; he sues for damages and emotional trauma.

own.us.title: Hot Bench
own.us.description: S07 E95 Pandemic Destroys Couple's Big Plans! A COVID shocker at a coffee shop, an emergency fundraiser and an "open" relationship dispute come into play when ex-lovers part.

own.us.title: Judge Judy
own.us.description: S24 E32 Holistic Doctor Taken to the Cleaners!; Carnival Daughter Sued by Mom The owner of a cleaning company goes after a former employee who denies stealing clients from him; a call to Child Protective Services, an eviction notice, and a newborn baby come into play when family members fight over reportedly stolen property.

own.us.title: Judge Judy
own.us.description: S24 E43 High School Reunion Fail! Decades after graduation, high school friends reconnect only to end up fighting over a large cash settlement and a custody battle.

own.us.title: Mathis Court With Judge Mathis ᴺᵉʷ
own.us.description: S01 E32 Barrel Bust & Ceilings and Shallow Waters A man seeks a refund, saying he was misled about the size of an at-home cryotherapy device; a landlord is blamed for a collapsed bathroom ceiling.

own.us.title: Mathis Court With Judge Mathis ᴺᵉʷ
own.us.description: S01 E87 To Punch or Not to Punch & A Lotto Tipping A man says his sister's ex-boyfriend punched him in the face; a dispute over winnings from a lottery ticket left as a tip.

own.us.title: Mathis Court With Judge Mathis ᴺᵉʷ
own.us.description: S01 E89 Late Performance & Bicycle Twins A woman blames a promoter for ruining her night, saying she waited hours for a concert to start; a stolen bike is returned damaged.

own.us.title: Mathis Court With Judge Mathis ᴺᵉʷ
own.us.description: S01 E99 Still Grooving & Table Game A man sues after missing a dance event because the wrong address was printed on the promotional flyer; a dispute between co-workers over a broken table.

own.us.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
own.us.description: S30 E19 Kid Vids, Near Misses, and Kids Getting Excited for Dumb Reasons Kids get excited for unusual reasons; a little boy is thrilled by online vacuum shopping; a little girl has a unique approach to making cookies; a musical tribute to pets.

own.us.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
own.us.description: S30 E03 Wisdom Teeth, Stumblebums, and Sensitive Startle Reflex Gender reveals gone awry; musical tribute to funny cats; people having funny reactions to dental surgeries; people who startle easily.

own.us.title: Family or Fiancé
own.us.description: S01 E06 Tselane and Justin: Old Traumas, New Dramas A former military man wants to marry a woman he met online and start a new life on the other side of the country; while his family is in the dark about his decision, his new fiancée grapples with the weight of his posttraumatic stress disorder.

own.us.title: Family or Fiancé
own.us.description: S01 E07 Briana and Nikkiya: Same Sex, Equal Mess It's a passionate plea for acceptance when two young women decide to surprise their families with news of their upcoming engagement; after the initial shock wears off, it is evident that the concerns for this couple run much deeper than gender.

pop.us.description: Maggie and OA must find a couple that is responsible for a spree of violent armed robberies that led to the death of an off-duty police officer.

pop.us.title: FBI - Exposed
pop.us.description: After an investigative journalist is murdered, the team uncovers information linking the suspect to past cases; the victim's death strikes a chord with Maggie, leaving her desperate for answers in regard to a traumatic event in her personal life.

pop.us.title: FBI - Scorched Earth
pop.us.description: A serial bomber appears to be targeting Wall Street's elite; Maggie and OA search for a suspect who seems set on revenge; Dana deals with Spencer Briggs, a cocky profiler brought in to consult on the case.

pop.us.title: FBI - Short Squeeze
pop.us.description: When the CEO of a major brokerage firm is killed while surrounded by protesters, the team looks into who had the most to lose from his company's perceived manipulations; Scola's previous Wall Street career and the reasons he left come to light.

pop.us.title: Scorpion - Twist and Shout
pop.us.description: A deadly tornado threatens the lives of Team Scorpion during a mission to recover the remains of fallen Marines in Vietnam.

pop.us.title: Scorpion - Hard Knox
pop.us.description: The team is hired by the Department of Defense to test the security at Fort Knox by trying to break in and steal a precious artifact.

pop.us.title: Scorpion - Chernobyl Intentions
pop.us.description: In Chernobyl, Sylvester and Paige become trapped inside a decaying nuclear reactor that the team is trying to repair before a tragic meltdown.

pop.us.title: NCIS - Knockout
pop.us.description: A boxer's death leads to Vance starting his own investigation; Gibbs looks into Vance's past.

pop.us.title: NCIS - Hide and Seek
pop.us.description: A military family comes under suspicion when a boy finds a murder weapon and the team must track ownership of the gun.

pop.us.title: NCIS - Dead Reckoning
pop.us.description: Gibbs reluctantly works with Trent Kort (David Dayan Fisher) to put away one of the department's most-wanted criminals.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Starter Home
pop.us.description: The team tracks a serial killer when remains of numerous victims are found in the walls of an elderly couple's home; the hunt becomes urgent after the BAU learns the killer's specific ritual of when to strike; Rossi reconnects with his ex-wife.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Rule 34
pop.us.description: Packages with gruesome contents are delivered to six people in the Washington, D.C. area; Simmons and Kristy struggle to connect with their son, David, who is suspended from school for aggressive behavior.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Last Gasp
pop.us.description: The BAU meets in secret to investigate a subject who appears to be kidnapping and photographing young women.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Sick and Evil
pop.us.description: The BAU investigates a string of murders taking place in supposedly haunted houses in Lewiston, Maine.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Chameleon
pop.us.description: Rossi questions his actions in the aftermath of a struggle with a serial killer who appears to have outsmarted the BAU.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Spectator Slowing
pop.us.description: The BAU team investigates a series of seemingly random fatal explosions throughout Kentucky and Tennessee.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Summer Camp: Ticked Off

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Dine and Bash; Sofa, So Good

400000090.title: Greed: A Seven Deadly Sins Story
400000090.description: When interior decorator Zuri Maxwell meets handsome benefactor and entrepreneur Godfrey Anderson, she compromises the values and morals that should guide her in an effort to be part of the moneyed world she so desperately wants to enter.

400000090.title: Envy: A Seven Deadly Sins Story
400000090.description: Gabrielle seems to have it all -- a devoted husband, a beautiful daughter and a successful career in public relations. However, she soon stands to lose everything when she meets Keisha, her devious half sister who wants everything Gabrielle has.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Arizona, a shipment of money vanished into the high desert, along with the two men hired to guard it. The FBI didn't know if the guards were participants or victims of an ambush. Answers lay somewhere in the thousands of square miles of Arizona's northwest territory. When the vehicle was recovered with three hundred thousand dollars and the drivers missing, suspicions that the crime was an inside job grew.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Alabama, a pair of convicted felons escaped the custody of a local deputy and fled across the country. Eluding authorities, they moved from state to state in a wave of abduction and car theft. When a foreign military officer disappeared along their trail, police and FBI agents wondered if the armed fugitives had become killers. Agents believed the pair were growing more violent and raced to find the escapees before more victims crossed their path.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1992, a young mother was gunned down in front of her children. Police searched for answers, but found none. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless, and random. Then, family members offered a startling clue. The victim, the wife of a prominent Atlanta attorney, was also a woman burdened with a secret; a secret the FBI believed led to her death. It would force local and federal agents to untangle an intricate web of money, drugs and murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Memphis, Tennessee, a horrible crime terrified local residents. When a wealthy young mother was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The twenty-five year old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband, and several spurned boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list. To find the woman and her abductor, investigators would have to first determine the motive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1997, a series of crimes in a small Iowa farming community left residents reeling in shock and fear. Two young men went on a crime spree of robbery, kidnapping and murder, and then disappeared. By the time they were identified, they already had a twelve-hour lead. As the hunt for the two men expanded, the FBI committed its resources to tracking down the suspects. The pursuit would take agents across six states to catch the killers before they struck again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 80's, Florida's cocaine imports were among the highest in the nation. Regional territories were enforced with intimidation and murder. Desperate to stop the violence, local authorities turned to the FBI for help. One dealer bowed to no one. He would stop at nothing to keep detectives and agents from building a case against him. When his organization began targeting the government itself, a city went on high alert.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Kokomo, Indiana an unthinkable crime terrified residents. A young woman was snatched from her home on a bright spring morning. Drops of blood and a torn window screen were all that was left to tell authorities what happened to the twenty-one year old victim. After several days of searching, a former FBI profiler narrowed the suspect list to one. Agents and detectives followed the trail across state lines hoping to find the victim before her time ran out.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In July 1997, a triple murder terrified residents in the nation's capital. In a Georgetown coffee shop, three employees were shot to death. Investigators could find no immediate suspects and no clear motive for the attack. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong, or an act of cold-blooded vengeance against one of the victims?

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1986, a small crime free Indiana town was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. After an officer was gunned down at point-blank range, the psychotic killer led investigators across the Midwest. No one knew where the gunman would strike next, even as his tally of murders and abductions grew. The FBI and state police raced against time to rescue America's heartland from this deranged gunman, before he killed again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Langley, Virginia, a gunman fired into rush hour traffic. The brazen daytime shooting of employees from the Central Intelligence Agency stunned the country. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political. The FBI was called in, but the nationwide search quickly became a far-reaching international manhunt. Agents processed more than 2000 leads and crossed an ocean in the effort to deliver justice.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her 10 year-old son was missing from his school. No one knew how it could have happened. Within hours, the boy's entire family was frantically searching for him. The few leads in the case quickly turned cold and the FBI was called in to aid in the investigation. The search by agents and local authorities would cover a thousand miles to expose the kidnapper and find the missing child.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On a summer afternoon in upscale Lodi, California, a 12-year-old girl is abducted from her home. Scores of police officers and FBI agents converge, determined to find the young girl before it is too late. When the kidnapper's car is discovered in a field near Lodi, police dogs, helicopters, and hundreds of volunteers are employed in a round-the-clock search. It would take a community united in concern for one of their youngest to find the missing child.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In rural Texas, 13-year-old is kidnapped on her way to school. Frantic to find her safely, her millionaire father calls local authorities and the FBI. As police officers and agents conduct aerial surveillance, the father drives hundreds of miles through the night to deliver the ransom cash to a drop that the kidnappers keep changing. In a final effort to save the young girl, investigators must engage in a dangerous firefight with five desperate criminals.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In September 1997, a team of masked gunmen robbed an armored car facility in Los Angeles, and made off with $18.9 million, the largest takeover heist in U.S. history. An employee believed she recognized the voice of one of the robbers, and FBI agents began conducting surveillance on a former employee of the facility. With only one piece of physical evidence, a fragment of a vehicle taillight, authorities hoped to connect him to the crime, and locate his accomplices.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In July 1996, two men entered a pawnshop in Birmingham, Alabama, and ruthlessly murdered the employees. Unbeknownst to the killers, a secret video surveillance camera recorded the shooting. Local police and the FBI released images of the crime to the media, and were quickly able to identify the perpetrators. Now authorities had to find two cold-blooded killers who knew that they were being pursued for murder one.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Lincoln County, Nebraska, a fugitive drug dealer engaged in a shootout with state troopers, wounding two of them, and eluded capture after a high-speed chase. Authorities immediately set up a statewide manhunt, connecting the fugitive to a murder in western Nebraska. A chance sighting led FBI agents to a second confrontation with the killer, who was more determined than ever to escape the law.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: After a career criminal committed a vehicular homicide in New Orleans, FBI agents tracked him through his habits and addictions. They focused their investigation on gambling communities throughout the country and, when he resurfaced in Atlantic City, authorities used all of their resources to trap an elusive sociopath who claimed that he would never be taken alive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1980's, a pair of serial bank robbers gained a reputation among law enforcement officials as formidable bandits. Using the same modus operandi, the two men took hostages and emptied bank vaults across the Midwest. After the criminals escaped from police custody, FBI agents familiar with the bandits believed that they would attempt a grand-scale heist. By conducting surveillance on known associates of the criminals, authorities tried to anticipate the next target.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the summer of 1999, Texas was terrorized by a brutal serial killer who traveled by train. The FBI assembled a task force to gather information about the dangerous drifter and create a profile that would help locate him. As they learned that the killer had traveled extensively through the United States and Mexico, the murders became more frequent, and authorities had to cast a dragnet over an entire continent in an effort to catch him.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On October 2, 1987, a Boston police officer responding to a domestic disturbance call was fatally wounded. Local authorities launched a citywide manhunt, but were only able to find the fingerprints of the chief suspect. Believing that he had fled the area, the FBI followed the suspect's trail to the west coast and then across the Mexican border, always aware of the desperation of a cop killer and of the need for justice.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In August 1984, the son of a successful real estate developer was kidnapped in front of his father's business in Miami. After the father received a $3 million ransom demand from a self-proclaimed terrorist, the FBI became involved. Based on witness descriptions of the car used in the kidnapping, authorities began to suspect a pair of Colombian nationals with a known grudge against the developer's family.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In October 1995, a South Carolina family was taken hostage as part of an elaborately planned bank robbery. Local police quickly identified two of the perpetrators, but the criminal mastermind proved more elusive. After his escape from custody, authorities began to suspect the fugitive of involvement in a series of bank robberies up and down the east coast, and the FBI remained on his trail, hoping to catch him before he took more hostages.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In February 1988, a record store clerk in Sandusky, Ohio, was fatally shot in his van. After discovering a night deposit bag with thousands of dollars in the vehicle, police knew that robbery was not the motive, and began to investigate other possibilities. FBI agents learned that several motorcycle gang members had been stopped nearby on a traffic violation shortly after the murder and theorized that the clerk's murder may have been a botched hit carried out by a gang member.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June 1973, a young girl was abducted from a state park on the Missouri River while camping with her family. Several months passed with no leads, then an FBI agent took a particular interest in the case. Using a new technique known as criminal profiling, he predicted that the kidnapper would contact the girl's family on the one-year anniversary of her abduction. When this prediction came true, the FBI agent noted behavioral clues, hoping that they could lead him to the kidnapper.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1996, a group of political extremists twice robbed a bank in Spokane, Washington, using homemade bombs and military precision to escape. The FBI learned that the robbers, part of a shadowy organization called the Phineas Priesthood, might be preparing for a small-scale war with law enforcement. After the suspects were identified, the FBI was faced with the task of safely arresting a group of terrorists with a deadly agenda.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In August 1992, a man returned to his Memphis home and discovered that his wife was missing. The husband, as well as his friends, family and neighbors began to receive ransom calls. FBI agents noticed that one neighbor seemed to have the best rapport with the kidnapper. They began to question his level of involvement, but had to proceed carefully, knowing that he could be their only link to the missing woman.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1990 and 1991, Chicago police and the FBI were on the trail of a bank robber whose holdups were becoming increasingly violent. The criminal consistently used stolen Japanese cars to carry out the robberies, so authorities hoped to identify him by tracking vehicle thefts. When they finally located the man known as the bearded bandit, they learned that he did not work alone and he had made a pact never to surrender.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1988, new light was shed on the mysterious death of a South Carolina farmer when a criminal confessed that two prominent community members hired him to commit murder. Local police and FBI agents arrested a wealthy businessman and later learned that, even behind bars, he commanded the power to corrupt and kill. Using prison informants, agents had to prevent him from murdering again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In October 1993, a robber surprised unsuspecting customers by dropping through the roof of a California bank. When police arrived, he escaped from the roof in a hail of bullets. A tip from a local resident led police and FBI agents to the perpetrator. They would soon learn that he had masterminded a local kidnapping, and held the fate of an innocent woman in his hands.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In January 1984, a U.S. Customs official disappears from his post near the Del Rio, Texas border crossing, prompting local police to search for four Latin American suspects driving a Pontiac Grand Prix. The following day, the Customs official was found dead. Two state troopers recovered the missing officer's service revolver after a fatal altercation with two men. Local police and the FBI continued searching for the suspect vehicle, prepared for a confrontation with desperate criminals.

400000096.description: In Modesto, two men struggle with high bail amounts, and a frequent flyer ends up back in jail after having a little too much boxed wine; in Virginia Beach, a man is arrested after getting in a fight with his girlfriend's ex over a litter of pit bull puppies.

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
actionmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
actionmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
actionmax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Aftermath

actionmax.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors

During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Musical comedy) - 1986

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxaction.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2001-12-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxaction.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-12-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxaction.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2007-06-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemaxaction.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Movie) - 2018-06-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Aftermath
cinemaxaction.us.description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter. (Action, Drama, Movie, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Thriller) - 2017-04-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors
cinemaxaction.us.description: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Comedy, Horror, Movie, Musical comedy) - 1986-12-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mickey 17
cinemaxaction.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Adventure, Comedy, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2025-01-31

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Gift
cinemaxaction.us.description: A new short film by Gary T. Smith, "The Gift," tells the story of a college senior who has her world rocked when she finds a homeless girl sleeping in her car on Christmas Eve. (Drama, Movie, Mystery, Sci-Fi & Fantasy) - 2022

cinemaxaction.us.title: Fantastic Beasts: A Natural History
cinemaxaction.us.description: Delving into the mythological, including dragons, mermaids, and unicorns -- alongside examinations of natural world beasts, such as vervet monkeys, narwhals, and manatees; Stephen Fry travels far and wide to learn about such animals. (Documentary, Nature, Show, Special) - 2022-02-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemaxaction.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Crime, Dark comedy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1971-02-02

cinemaxaction.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
cinemaxaction.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Comedy) - 2021-08-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: Space Jam
cinemaxaction.us.description: Swackhammer (Danny DeVito), an evil alien theme park owner, needs a new attraction at Moron Mountain. When his gang, the Nerdlucks, heads to Earth to kidnap Bugs Bunny (Billy West) and the Looney Tunes, Bugs challenges them to a basketball game to determine their fate. The aliens agree, but they steal the powers of NBA basketball players, including Larry Bird (Larry Bird) and Charles Barkley (Charles Barkley) -- so Bugs gets some help from superstar Michael Jordan (Michael Jordan). (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Comedy, Family) - 1996-11-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
cinemaxaction.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2021-07-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxaction.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1992-06-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Patti Cake$
cinemaxaction.us.description: Fed up with life in her New Jersey hometown, Patricia Dombrowski, aka Patti Cake$, hopes to follow in the footsteps of her idol and hit the road to achieve stardom as a rapper. With help from her best friend, a mysterious musician and her loving grandmother, Patti leads the charge against an army of haters, unpaid bills and the broken dreams that are holding her back. (Drama, Hip-Hop & Rap, Movie, Music) - 2017-01-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Extraction
cinemaxaction.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-12-18

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Possession
cinemaxaction.us.description: When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-08-31

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Wolfman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy. (Action, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-02-11

cinemaxaction.us.title: Trap
cinemaxaction.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Crime, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2024-08-02

cinemaxaction.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2011-06-02

cinemaxaction.us.title: MacGruber
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2010-05-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
cinemaxaction.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime, Crime drama, Dark comedy, Drama, Movie) - 2017-09-04

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mass Ave
cinemaxaction.us.description: A racial profiling incident forever changes the relationship between a man and his son. (Crime, Drama, Movie) - 2021-11-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Lord of the Flies
cinemaxaction.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1963

cinemaxaction.us.title: Gimme Shelter
cinemaxaction.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (Documentary, Movie, Music) - 1970-12-06

cinemaxaction.us.title: For All Mankind
cinemaxaction.us.description: Directed by Al Reinert and with music scored by Brian Eno, "For All Mankind" provides a testament to NASA's Apollo program of the 1960s and '70s. Composed of actual NASA footage of the missions and astronaut interviews, the documentary offers the viewpoint of the individuals who braved the remarkable journey to the moon and back. While compiling the material for the film, Reinert went through more than six million feet of film of these historic moments. (Documentary, History, Movie) - 1989-11-01

cinemaxaction.us.title: Flashpoint
cinemaxaction.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action, Crime, Movie, Thriller, Western) - 1984

cinemaxaction.us.title: Hall Pass
cinemaxaction.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy, Movie, Romance) - 2011-02-25

cinemaxaction.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxaction.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hué. (Drama, Historical drama, Movie, War) - 1987-06-01

cinemaxaction.us.title: Scanners
cinemaxaction.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1981-01-14

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, prewedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy, Movie) - 2011-05-26

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Man
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2005-09-09

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Catfish
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 2010-01-22

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Sweet Dreams
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography, Drama, Movie, Music, Romance) - 1985-10-02

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1955-04-24

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Player
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1992-04-03

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ricochet
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (Action, Crime, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1991

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Country, Drama, Folk, Gospel) - 2005-11-18

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Adventure, Comedy, Movie, Music) - 2010-06-04

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1999-01-25

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxclassics.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Mystery) - 2000-10-27

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Open Water
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Adventure, Drama, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2003-10-26

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra. (Action, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1964-04-29

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Hop
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Animated, Animation, Comedy, Family, Holiday) - 2011-03-31

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Crime, Movie, Thriller) - 1960-08-10

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2001-12-07

cinemaxclassics.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-12-09

Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2007-06-07

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Green Zone
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Chief Warrant Officer Roy Miller and his team of inspectors are on a mission in 2003 to find Iraq's reported stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction. Traveling from one dangerous site to another, Miller and his team fail to find any chemical agents or other weapons. Instead, they discover an elaborate coverup in which the most-elusive weapon is truth. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-03-11

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. (Comedy, Horror, Movie, Musical comedy) - 1986-12-19

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives - A Star Is Born
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Clover must leave her family behind to compete in an algorithm-based singing competition; pressure from the judges leads Clover to doubt herself, but her family's words give her the strength to perform. (Comedy, Community, Drama, Series) - 2025-07-07

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Talk Black
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A timid engineer develops a wild and expressive split personality that helps her stand up to male co-workers. (Comedy, Movie) - 2021

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Skin Can Breathe
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A gay teen tries to adjust to a new life after moving from Cambodia to America with his mother. (Drama, LGBTQ, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Show, Special) - 2022-05-19

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Destroy All Monsters!
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Scientists face Godzilla, Rodan, Mothra and more obscure Japanese monsters sent by she-aliens. (Action, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1968-08-01

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Godzilla, King of the Monsters!
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1956-04-27

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Christmas With the Kranks
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Finally alone for the holidays, Luther (Tim Allen) and Nora Krank (Jamie Lee Curtis) plan to eschew the Christmas traditions and take a cruise in the Caribbean instead. This doesn't sit well with their Christmas-obsessed neighbors Vic Frohmeyer (Dan Aykroyd) and Walt Scheel (M. Emmet Walsh), who are determined to win the annual "best decorated street" competition, and the Kranks soon find themselves social outcasts because of their lack of Christmas spirit. (Comedy, Family, Holiday, Movie) - 2004-11-20

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
cinemaxclassics.us.description: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (Action, Adventure, Children, Comedy, Family) - 1992

cinemaxclassics.us.title: MacGruber
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2010-05-21

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Head Office

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Due Date
