tlc.uk.description: The Confirmation. Frankie and Mike send Brick to a religious weekend camp. He is shocked to discover that his bunkmate is the boy he was switched at birth with. S8, Ep19

tlc.uk.title: The Middle
tlc.uk.description: Adult Swim. Frankie is thrilled when Axl agrees to let her take him shopping to help him pick out a suit. Mike threatens to get rid of the pool if no one's using it. S8, Ep20

tlc.uk.title: The Middle
tlc.uk.description: Clear And Present Danger. Frankie frantically searches the house for Axl's missing graduation gift. Sue decides that she wants to make a sweet video for Mike's upcoming birthday. S8, Ep21

tlc.uk.title: Young Sheldon
tlc.uk.description: Family Dynamics And Red Fiero. Sheldon studies his family for a psychology project when their Thanksgiving dinner turns into a fight after George Sr. is offered a job in Oklahoma. S2, Ep9

tlc.uk.title: Young Sheldon
tlc.uk.description: Stunted Childhood. When Sheldon learns that stunted childhoods can turn people into outcasts, he tries to act his age. Meemaw and Dr. Sturgis's relationship is tested. S2, Ep10

tlc.uk.title: Young Sheldon
tlc.uk.description: Race Of Superhumans. While Missy unknowingly becomes Sheldon's test subject, Georgie joins Mary's Bible study to spend more time with his crush, Veronica. S2, Ep11

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Hamburger Postulate. Fearing he's wasting his time on Penny, Leonard makes a connection with Leslie. Meanwhile, Sheldon frets over a change to his hamburger routine. S1, Ep5

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Middle Earth Paradigm. Penny hosts a Halloween party, putting Leonard, Sheldon, Wolowitz and Koothrappali through a new test of their social skills. S1, Ep6

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Dumpling Paradox. When Wolowitz goes AWOL with one of her friends, Penny's recruited to fill in for him on the guys' Halo team. S1, Ep7

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Grasshopper Experiment. Raj's parents set him up on a blind date, and when he discovers he can talk to her, she shows interest in Sheldon. S1, Ep8

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: Cooper-Hofstadter Polarization. When they're invited to present at a physics conference, Sheldon's reluctance to share the credit leads to a tiff between him and Leonard. S1, Ep9

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Loobenfeld Decay. Leonard and Sheldon each lie to avoid hearing Penny sing in a production of Rent. However, Sheldon's lie becomes a bit too complicated. S1, Ep10

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Pancake Batter Anomaly. With his friends knowing how sour he acts when sick and avoiding him as a result, Sheldon is nursed by Penny, who hasn't a clue what she's in for. S1, Ep11

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Jerusalem Duality. With Sheldon rattled after meeting Dennis, a teen physicist who's smarter than he is, the rest of the guys search for a way to eliminate the threat. S1, Ep12

tlc.uk.title: The Middle
tlc.uk.description: The Final Final. Axl pleads with his teacher to let him take his final college exam or he won't be able to graduate. Sue and Brad perform an impromptu musical number. S8, Ep22

tlc.uk.title: The Middle
tlc.uk.description: Fight Or Flight. Having finally graduated college, Axl tells Frankie and Mike that he's planning on going to Europe over the summer with Kenny. S8, Ep23

tlc.uk.title: The Middle
tlc.uk.description: Vive La Hecks. Axl returns home from his summer trip to Europe, sporting a man-bun and with a new, chill European outlook on life. S9, Ep1

tlc.uk.title: Young Sheldon
tlc.uk.description: Tummy Ache And Whale Metaphor. When Sheldon has to spend a few days in the hospital, he turns into the world's worst patient, and his behaviour takes a toll on everyone. S2, Ep12

tlc.uk.title: Young Sheldon
tlc.uk.description: Nuclear Reactor And Boy Lovey. While Sheldon attempts to build a nuclear reactor to power the neighbourhood, Georgie is heartbroken when he learns that Veronica has a boyfriend. S2, Ep13

tlc.uk.title: Young Sheldon
tlc.uk.description: David, Goliath And A Yoo-hoo. Sheldon uses his new friendship with the school bully to boss Georgie around. Also, Missy steals Meemaw's makeup for Picture Day. S2, Ep14

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Bat Jar Conjecture. Sheldon finds himself booted from the gang's Physics Bowl team and replaced with Leslie, so he forms his own team hoping to prove he's superior. S1, Ep13

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Nerdvana Annihilation. When the delivery of a full-size prop of 1960's 'The Time Machine' causes Penny to miss work, she scolds Leonard about his sci-fi collectibles. S1, Ep14

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Pork Chop Indeterminacy. The gang fall for Sheldon's twin sister, and Leonard's plan to win her heart is derailed when Sheldon declares he'll decide who can date her. S1, Ep15

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Peanut Reaction. Penny wants to throw a surprise party for Leonard, but Sheldon's indulgence at an electronics store throws her off-track. S1, Ep16

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Tangerine Factor. Penny's breakup spurs Leonard to summon the courage to ask her out, and they both go to Sheldon for advice on their upcoming date. S1, Ep17

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Bad Fish Paradigm. Penny opens up to Sheldon after a less-than-stellar first date with Leonard, placing him in the uncomfortable position of having to keep a secret. S2, Ep1

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Codpiece Topology. Seeing Penny with another guy sends Leonard back to Leslie Winkle, much to Sheldon's dismay. S2, Ep2

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Barbarian Sublimation. Penny becomes addicted to an online game based on the world of Conan the Barbarian and persistently pesters Sheldon for advice. S2, Ep3

tlc.uk.title: Mock The Week
tlc.uk.description: Dara Ó Briain extracts humour from current events with guests Rhys James, Neil Delamere, Milton Jones, Zoe Lyons, Sara Pascoe and Ahir Shah. S2, Ep7

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Kings Row
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the 1890s, friends from both sides of the tracks in the village of Kings Row look for love despite the barriers of family and class. Aspiring doctor Parris Mitchell (Robert Cummings) loves the mysterious Cassandra Tower (Betty Field), despite her dark family secrets. Drake McHugh (Ronald Reagan) loses his trust fund and must go to work, but when his legs are amputated after an accident, his depression colors his relationship with feisty working-class girl Randy Monaghan (Ann Sheridan). (Drama) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Command Decision
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At an American air base on English soil, Brigadier General K.C. Dennis (Clark Gable) commands a group of B-17 bombers that run missions over Nazi Germany. Having suffered severe losses on several recent missions and with some of the men under his command getting into scrapes with the military police, Dennis is under increasing pressure to explain his mounting casualty rates to both a cynical war correspondent (Charles Bickford) and a visiting congressman (Edward Arnold). (War, Drama) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Arsenic and Old Lace
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Writer and notorious marriage detractor Mortimer Brewster (Cary Grant) falls for girl-next-door Elaine Harper (Priscilla Lane), and they tie the knot on Halloween. When the newlyweds return to their respective family homes to deliver the news, Brewster finds a corpse hidden in a window seat. With his eccentric aunts (Josephine Hull, Jean Adair), disturbed uncle (John Alexander), and homicidal brother (Raymond Massey), he starts to realize that his family is even crazier than he thought. (Comedy) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: I Married a Witch
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Just as she is about to be burned at the stake for witchcraft, 17th century witch Jennifer (Veronica Lake) casts a curse on the family of her accuser, dooming all the men of future generations to marry the wrong women. Freed from her ethereal prison some 250 years later, Jennifer decides to make the most recent descendant of her accuser (Fredric March) even more miserable by using a love potion on him that makes him fall in love with her, a plan that has unexpected results. (Fantasy) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: A Stolen Life
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Reserved Kate Bosworth (Bette Davis) returns home to Cape Cod to work on her painting, and meets and falls in love with young engineer Bill Emerson (Glenn Ford), who is working at the lighthouse for the summer. When Bill meets Kate's twin, Pat, he mistakes her for Kate and is confused by and drawn to her charged sensuality. Heartbroken when Bill marries Pat, Kate buries herself in her work and the coaching of angry artist Karnock (Dane Clark), until an improbable situation arises involving Bill. (Drama) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Stranger
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Immediately following World War II, ex-Nazi Franz Kindler is living under a false identity as a teacher in a small Connecticut town, and has even married the headmaster's daughter as part of his cover. But when one of Kindler's old German associates arrives unexpectedly in town, bringing in his wake a sly federal investigator, Kindler resorts to desperate measures to preserve his secret. (Thriller) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Deathtrap
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When once-successful playwright Sidney Bruhl (Michael Caine) sees his latest Broadway effort bomb on its opening night, he tumbles into despair -- until he receives a package from his former student Clifford Anderson (Christopher Reeve). Inside is an unproduced script that's better than anything Sidney has written in years. At the urging of his wife, Myra (Dyan Cannon), Sidney undertakes a plan to lure Clifford to his country home, murder him and then announce the script as his own work. (Mystery) - 1982

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ten Little Indians
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a group of 10 strangers is invited to a party at a mansion in the Alps, each arrives expecting entertainment. However, a recorded message from their absent host informs them that each guest has been responsible for someone's death, and consequently each will be killed. Quickly, members of the party begin to turn up dead. American Hugh Lombard (Hugh O'Brian) and the beautiful Ann Clyde (Shirley Eaton) try to determine the identity of the murderer before they become the next victims. (Mystery, Crime drama) - 1965

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: A Night of Adventure
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A lawyer (Tom Conway) tries discreetly to defend his wife's (Audrey Long) artist boyfriend for murder. (Crime drama) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Upperworld
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Millionaire railroad baron Alex Stream (Warren William) is drifting apart from his wife, Hettie (Mary Astor), who devotes her attention to climbing the social ladder. While sailing his yacht, Alex saves burlesque performer Lilly Linda (Ginger Rogers) from drowning, and the two become friends. Despite the chaste nature of their friendship, Lilly's boyfriend and manager, Lou Colima (J. Carrol Naish), notices her liking for Alex and tries to use the millionaire's letters to Lilly for blackmail. (Crime drama) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Private Detective 62
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A down-and-out private eye (William Powell) falls for a woman (Margaret Lindsay) he has been hired to frame. (Crime drama) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Second Chance
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After accidentally killing a man in the ring, boxer Russ Lambert (Robert Mitchum) needs to escape from his old life and regain his composure. Meanwhile, singer Clare Sinclair (Linda Darnell) is on the run from her gangster boyfriend, Vic Spilato, who wants to keep her from his murder trial. As the two cross paths in South America, Rush faces a whole new set of problems when Clare involves him in her affairs -- especially since hit man Cappy Gordon (Jack Palance) is on her trail. (Thriller) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Secret Bride
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An attorney general (Warren William) secretly marries the daughter (Barbara Stanwyck) of a governor accused of bribery. (Drama) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Danger Signal
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After robbing and murdering his married lover and then making her death look like suicide, conniving philanderer Ronnie Mason (Zachary Scott) relocates to Los Angeles. Under a new identity and claiming to be a writer, Ronnie finds lodging at the home of Hilda Fenchurch (Faye Emerson) and her mother. He woos Hilda, knowing she has money, but when he discovers that Hilda's sister, Anne (Mona Freeman), has just inherited $25,000, he switches his attentions to her. (Crime drama) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Betrayed
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Naive waitress Millie (Kim Hunter) is aboard a train, intending to rendezvous with her husband, Paul (Dean Jagger), whom she married after a whirlwind courtship. Arriving in New York, she has trouble finding Paul, but keeps running into her old beau Fred (Robert Mitchum). Though heartbroken by Millie's marriage, Fred helps her track down her elusive husband. As they follow Paul's trail, they discover evidence that implicates him in a grisly unsolved murder. (Mystery) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Secret Fury
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The wedding of Ellen (Claudette Colbert) and David (Robert Ryan) is halted by a stranger who insists that the bride is already married to someone else. Though the flabbergasted Ellen denies the charge, the interloper produces enough evidence that his accusation must be investigated. Ellen and David travel to the small coastal town where her first wedding allegedly occurred. There, they meet a number of individuals whose stories make Ellen question her own sanity. (Mystery) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Shadow of Doubt
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a Hollywood producer is murdered, the most likely suspect is a man who is smitten with the victim's fiancée. (Mystery) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 100 Rifles
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When half-breed Indian Yaqui Joe (Burt Reynolds) robs an Arizona bank, he is pursued by dogged lawman Lyedecker (Jim Brown). Fleeing to Mexico, Joe is imprisoned by General Verdugo (Fernando Lamas), who is waging a war against the Yaqui Indians. When Lyedecker attempts to intervene, he is thrown into prison as well. Working together, the two escape and take refuge in the hills, where Lyedecker meets beautiful Yaqui freedom fighter Sarita (Raquel Welch) and begins to question his allegiances. (Western) - 1969

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Greatest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Boxer Cassius Clay (Muhammad Ali) trains with Angelo Dundee (Ernest Borgnine), becomes heavyweight champion and converts to Islam. - 1977

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Black Eye
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An ex-police officer operating a private detective business comes face to face with a syndicate-backed dope ring. - 1974

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Black Belt Jones
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A martial artist (Jim Kelly) helps a father (Scatman Crothers) and daughter (Gloria Hendry) save their school of self-defense from Los Angeles mobsters. - 1974

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Hit Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An avenger (Bernie Casey) wades through the Los Angeles porno underworld in the name of his dead brother. - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cain and Mabel
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A chorus girl (Marion Davies) and a heavyweight boxer (Clark Gable) are paired romantically as a publicity stunt. - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Brother Rat and a Baby
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Virginia Military Institute graduates keep busy as an illustrator, football coach and rich man's son. - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Susan and God
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A socialite (Joan Crawford) annoys her husband (Fredric March) and friends with the new religion she brings home from England. - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Damon and Pythias
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Greek tyrant Dionysius puts the friendship of two men (Don Burnett, Guy Williams) to a life-or-death test. - 1962

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Abbott and Costello in Hollywood
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two bumbling barbers (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) act as agents for an unknown singer and stage a phony murder to get him a coveted role. - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Judge Hardy and Son
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The judge (Lewis Stone) guides Andy (Mickey Rooney) through problems with girls, money and an essay contest. - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bonnie and Clyde
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Acclaimed account of the gun-toting bank robbers and the trail of terror they blazed through the Southwest in the '30s. - 1967

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E22 Episode 22 We go Italian with guest cook Dezi Madafferi as she prepares a delicious Crumbed Veal Cotoletta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E22 Osso Bucco It's sandwich night in Rachael's kitchen and she's serving up an array of Italian sandwiches with ingredients like roasted eggplant, sweet bell peppers, spicy mortadella with pistachio, and much more.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E4 Tasmania's North West Hayden explores the wild beauty of North West Tasmania, where dramatic coastlines and lush farmlands produce some of the country's finest ingredients.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E12 Episode 12 It's a Chocolate lovers dream on today's Sweet Edition.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E17 Episode 17 Laura starts with delicious Monte Carlo Biscuits which she shares with Stallholder John Pino. Catherine Velisha makes a Cucumber Smash, a quick and easy salad that is chock-full of vegetables.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E15 Episode 15 Rick visits his favourite local fish market at Looe in Cornwall, and he cooks John Dory with potatoes and mushrooms. In Northumberland, Rick cooks up pancakes with cheese, spinach, and ham.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E79 Sunset Supper Join journalist Janice Petersen, chef Matt Golinski and Adam for a night of superb sunset suppers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E11 Winter Salad Jamie has been invited on a local shoot and uses the opportunity to explore the world of delicious game birds.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E18 Buonavia When Lidia was in her 20's, she opened Buonavia, her first restaurant. With a menu that are favourites to her homeland; beef and potato goulash, crespelle with cherries, chocolate, and cream.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Ireland Ireland's history of making cheese dates back to ancient Celtic times. Will explores the spectacularly rugged west coast of Ireland to try some of the more unusual cheese varieties.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: What Chefs Want
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Heritage Cuisine And Medicinal Food Chef Damian D'Silva uncovers the fascinating history and medicinal properties of Singapore's traditional cuisine. From the healing power of ginger to the time-honoured recipes of Peranakan cuisine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Apricale Nestled in the Ligurian hinterland, Apricale feels suspended in time. Here, Luana disconnects from the modern world for an authentic and poetic escape.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 500 Miles Sophie discovers the culinary delights of the Puglian coastline. She learns all about the sea urchin and how it's used with spaghetti. She also makes a delicious pasta sauce with the leftovers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E10 Ali & Mitch Torres: Barni (Goanna) Caesar Salad & PAN Fried Damper Ali and Mitch take the bush goanna and give it a dressing up in this recipe of the traditional Caesar Salad, replacing the chicken and eggs with chunky pieces of Barni and served with damper.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Pizzas Not many of us are lucky enough to have a wood oven in the back yard. But all is not lost. If you want to make brilliant home cooked pizzas, all you need is a conventional oven.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E23 Episode 23 In the heart of the beautiful McLaren Vale, Laura is joined by her chef husband, Max, to whip up a simple but awesome Italian dish, Spaghetti Aglio Olio E Pepperoncino.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E23 Truffle Eggs With Chips And Chives Living in Tuscany allows for the enjoyment of a long truffle season, Rachael shows how to use local truffles to add amazing flavour to a fun and decadent dish of scrambled eggs and potato chips.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E5 More North West Tasmania Still in Tasmania's north west, Hayden hunts down the ultimate ingredients for his dream dessert-cooked on a BBQ. From windswept shores to artisan kitchens, this is Tasmania at its most delicious.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E1 Eric Ripert The incredible chef and world class restaurateur behind the three Michelin star Le Bernardin restaurant in New York, Eric Ripert, is cooking at the barn and sharing life-changing stories.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E18 Episode 18 Laura is joined by Sweet Greek's Kathy Tsaples to make amygdalota, Greek almond-based cookies; Asian Inspirations' chef Kinsan makes S&B curry noodles; Laura makes her cheat's ramen.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia In Vietnam
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Hanoi In Hanoi, Luke learns about the work of pioneering social enterprise, KOTO, and enjoys some of his favourite street food, including the city's signature dish of Cha Ca.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E47 Episode 47 When life is a little crumby make yourself feel a whole lot better by adding some crumbs mixed with fresh herbs and coat your delicious ingredients with it!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E80 Powered Powders Adam is joined by cook Lilly Wright and comedian Sashi Perera to unleash the power of spice powders.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Field Trip with Curtis Stone: Hong Kong
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 The Next Generation Having spent a day and night in Hong Kong, Curtis wakes early to learn all about how a bean curd factory got the attention of the Michelin guide and how a daughter's vision led her father's business.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Store Cupboard SOS This episode Nigella shares the secrets to fabulous fast food, and brilliant time-saving hacks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E11 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 1 The Time Lords send the Doctor, Sarah and Harry to Skaro at a point in time shortly before the creation of the Daleks. The Doctor's mission is to destroy his greatest enemy.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E12 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 2 The Doctor finds that some of Davros’s fellow Kaleds are unhappy with the development of the Daleks. Sarah is forced to load a Thal war rocket with radioactive explosives.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E13 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 3 The Doctor informs the Kaled government of Davros’s experiments and they move to shut down the bunker. But Davros is one step ahead and prepares to take drastic action.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E14 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 4 When the Kaled dome is destroyed by the Thals’ rocket, the war appears to be over and the Thals rejoice at their victory. But then, the Daleks appear and a massacre begins.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E15 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 5 With Harry and Sarah his prisoners, Davros interrogates the Doctor, forcing him to reveal the future of the Daleks so that he can learn from their defeats to make them stronger.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E16 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 6 The Kaled scientific elite move to prevent the development of the Daleks while the Doctor prepares to destroy them forever. But is it already too late?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E17 Revenge of the Cybermen: Part 1 The Doctor, Sarah and Harry return to Nerva, but at an earlier point in time. The crew are dying from a space plague but the Doctor suspects a survivor may be responsible.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E18 Revenge of the Cybermen: Part 2 Sarah is the latest victim of the space plague and the only way to cure her is by transmatting her down to the surface of the mysterious planetoid, Voga.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E19 Revenge of the Cybermen: Part 3 The Cybermen who are intent on destroying Voga. The Doctor and two of the Nerva crew become walking bombs which they Cybermen will detonate once they reach their target.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E20 Revenge of the Cybermen: Part 4 Their plan to blow up Voga thwarted, the Cybermen intend to crash Nerva into the planet. Vorus is almost ready to launch his rocket at Nerva, but Sarah is still trapped on board.

BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E5 Planet of Evil: Part 1 The TARDIS takes the Doctor and Sarah to the planet Zeta Minor on the edge of the universe. An unseen menace has wiped out an Morestran expedition and haunts the alien jungle.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E6 Planet of Evil: Part 2 The Doctor and Sarah are held responsible for the deaths on Zeta Minor, but the Doctor knows that the real culprit comes from the mysterious universe of antimatter.

BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E8 Planet of Evil: Part 4 Unable to escape, the Morestran probe is being pulled back to the surface of Zeta Minor. Onboard the ship, the Doctor and Sarah are hemmed in by anti-men.

BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E9 Pyramids of Mars: Part 1 The TARDIS lands in 1911. In the grounds of the Old Priory, Egyptian mummies are walking and the Doctor and Sarah discover that an ancient and powerful evil is manifesting itself.

BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E11 Pyramids of Mars: Part 3 The mummies are building a rocket to fire at the pyramid on Mars which will release Sutekh. The Doctor is determined to destroy the rocket but is Sutekh’s will too strong?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E12 Pyramids of Mars: Part 4 Inside the pyramid on Mars, the Doctor and Sarah must solve puzzles and escape traps to prevent Sutekh’s release from his imprisonment – but are they too late?

BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E10 Pyramids of Mars: Part 2 The Doctor, Sarah and Laurence Scarman are being hunted down by Sutekh’s robot mummies. The Doctor has a plan disrupt Sutekh’s control signal, but will it work?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E11 Pyramids of Mars: Part 3 The mummies are building a rocket to fire at the pyramid on Mars which will release Sutekh. The Doctor is determined to destroy the rocket but is Sutekh’s will too strong?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E12 Pyramids of Mars: Part 4 Inside the pyramid on Mars, the Doctor and Sarah must solve puzzles and escape traps to prevent Sutekh’s release from his imprisonment – but are they too late?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E13 The Android Invasion: Part 1 The TARDIS arrives back on Earth but all is not as it seems as the Doctor and Sarah are attacked by mysterious space suited figures and discover that the dead are walking..

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E14 The Android Invasion: Part 2 The TARDIS arrives back on Earth but all is not as it seems as the Doctor and Sarah are attacked by mysterious space suited figures and discover that the dead are walking.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E15 The Android Invasion: Part 3 The Kraals intend to invade Earth by stowing away aboard Crayford’s rocket as it returns home. The Doctor learns Styggron’s plan is to wipe out all life on the planet.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E16 The Android Invasion: Part 4 The Doctor and Sarah are desperate to warn UNIT of the Kraal’s invasion, but nobody will believe them. The Kraal’s release their android duplicates, including one of the Doctor.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E17 The Brain of Morbius: Part 1 The Doctor and Sarah arrive on the planet Karn. There they take shelter in the castle of Dr Solon who is secretly hiding the living brain of the Time Lord criminal, Morbius.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E18 The Brain of Morbius: Part 2 The Doctor is a prisoner of the Sisterhood of Karn who intend to burn him at the stake. Sarah hurries to the Doctor’s rescue but pays the price for her efforts.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E19 The Brain of Morbius: Part 3 Sarah has been blinded and the Doctor asks the Sisterhood for help. Morbius, fearful that the Time Lords have tracked him down, tells Solon to install his brain in a new body.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E20 The Brain of Morbius: Part 4 Morbius, housed in a terrifying new body, lives and breathes once more and the Doctor is forced to challenge his foe to a deadly mental duel which only one of them will survive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E21 The Seeds of Doom: Part 1 When the Doctor learns of the discovery of two alien seed pods in the Antarctic, he and Sarah rush to investigate. But they are too late. A man is already turning into a Krynoid.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E22 The Seeds of Doom: Part 2 The Krynoid is on the loose in the arctic. Scorby and Keeler have been sent to steal the alien pod and are willing to resort to murder to cover their tracks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E23 The Seeds of Doom: Part 3 The Doctor and Sarah track down the remaining Krynoid pod to the estate of Harrison Chase. The millionaire botanist intends use the pod to change a human victim into a Krynoid.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E24 The Seeds of Doom: Part 4 Keeler has been infected by the alien pod and is transforming into a Krynoid. Chase refuses to listen to the Doctor’s warning and throws him into a compost machine.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E25 The Seeds of Doom: Part 5 The Krynoid demands that the Doctor be surrendered to it. But the Doctor escapes to seek help. Sarah and Scorby, still trapped on the estate, battle against the living plants.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E26 The Seeds of Doom: Part 6 The Doctor, Sarah and Scorby are hunted down by the mad Harrison Chase. Outside the Krynoid prepares to germinate, sending its deadly seed pods out across the land.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S14 E4 The Masque of Mandragora: Part 4 As the leading scholars of the era assemble for the masque, Mandragora prepares to attack.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E6 Spellbound Nya has proof of Chen's plan but he entices the contestants to hunt her down with promises to advance the winner, forcing the Ninja in a race to get to her first.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Learn A Word
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E12 Love Learn to spell and write the word Love. This series shows an easy way to learn the basic words used in English, based on the Australian National Curriculum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Alphablocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E6 An Apple a Day In a play hospital doctors fail to cure Alphablock A with a bandage from their BAG. A RAM is no use. A HAT makes A too hot. A FAN makes her too cold. A NAP helps. An apple is best!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E12 Purple Imaginative Purple arrives in Colourland. Learn about the colour purple with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E12 Double Doors, Double Locked When Numberblocks One to Five take on Fifteen's challenge to unlock every door they need help from the Super Special Secret Step Squad.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E14 Along Came a Space Spider! Three baby Space Spiders swing around Reader Valley leaving it all webbed up!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E6 How Is It Made? Carrots Maddie visits a farm to find out how carrots grow from tiny seeds into big carrots we can eat.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E12 Log Pot Party Millie, Harper and Xavier, explore a garden to look for plants that survive and thrive in unusual places. They decide to turn dead logs and branches into mini gardens. It's a Log Pot Party!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Horrible Histories
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E10 Wily Winston Churchill We follow Churchill from a young soldier in India during the time of Queen Victoria, through the First World War to victory in WWII and finally to his retirement in the Swinging Sixties.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Past to Present ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 Ancient Greece Discover the amazing world of ancient Greece, including trend-setting temples, the ancient Olympics and the famous story of Demeter and Persephone.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Ancient World Greece
ABCMESydney.au.description: E3 Citizenship Citizenship was an important concept that the ancient Greeks imparted to the modern-day Western world. It dictated both social privilege and expectations about how you would live your life as a member of a city-state.

ABCMESydney.au.title: BTN
ABCMESydney.au.description: E30 Episode 30 Amelia Moseley takes a look at some of the major news stories of the week and explains the issues and events for school aged Australians.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Stories of Modern Australia ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Federation of Australian Colonies Unpack the fascinating story of Federation, and how the six separate colonies united to form a nation.

ABCMESydney.au.title: BtN Newsbreak
ABCMESydney.au.description: E191 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E2 Cornwall George meets a couple who are trading in their house for a debt free life in a cool, luxury American trailer. And George meets Caroline, who is building a writing den, created out of other people's cast-offs.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E2 Escape Room As a surprise for Lee's birthday, Lucy invites the family to join them in an escape room. The event proves hard to forget, with Lee handcuffed to a bomb, a 'traitor' in the room, and Toby's work life called into question.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E4 MI5 is asked to intervene when the latest round of Middle East peace talks is abruptly halted after a key delegate disappears.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E6 Give Me the Finger Holmes and Watson enter the world of nuclear security when they investigate the murder of an ex-Yakuza gang member.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E1 Dr, Carter, I Presume Carter starts his first day as a lowly surgical intern and finds himself more stressed than ever. Carol goes back to working in the ER. Peter finds out he is HIV negative, but Jeanie Boulet's HIV results are life-changing.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E20 Hi, My Name Is.. Evan is thrilled to open his first bank account, but is unsure whether to use his American name or his Taiwanese name, leading Louis and Jessica to reveal how each of them acquired their American names and how they first met.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E7 Horrible This episode of QI is a wholesale homage to all that is 'horrible'. Joining QI Master Stephen Fry are panellists Alan Davies, Dara O'Briain, Sean Lock and Chris Addison.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E6 Rhod Gilbert, Jamie Laing, Tracy-ann Oberman & Claudia Winkleman Host Rob Brydon is joined by team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack along with guests Rhod Gilbert, Jamie Laing, Tracy-Ann Oberman and Claudia Winkleman as they try to deceive their opponents with plausible lies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E20 End With A Bang The Mythbusters turns their attention to idioms. Can you hit the ground running? And is it really better to end with a bang?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E7 Chris Packham, Arlene Phillips, Ali Jawad In this seventh heat, nine artists are challenged to create a portrait of one of three celebrities: nature presenter and campaigner Chris Packham, choreographer Arlene Phillips and champion power lifter Ali Jawad.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E3 Lancashire George travels to Lancashire to meet Billy, a remarkable 17 year old self-builder who single-handedly transforms a derelict narrow boat his mum bought, into a hand crafted floating holiday home.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E19 Dev Griffin, Alex Horne, Debbie McGee and June Sarpong test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E8 Miss Kaninna, Tommy Little, Don West & Geraldine Hickey It's story time on Spicks with Justine Clarke. There's a bear in there and people as well, with Alan, Myf and Adam joined by Miss Kaninna, Tommy Little, Don West, Geraldine Hickey and a stunning performance by Montaigne.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E8 Q-animals Sandi Toksvig looks at animals which start with q, with Alan Davies, Daliso Chaponda, Phill Jupitus and Cariad Lloyd.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E9 The Unseen Bits Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return for an episode of previously unseen material from the comedy panel show. Over the course of the show, celebrity guests reveal amazing stories about themselves. But are they true?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hard Quiz
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E23 Tom Gleeson puts four more self-proclaimed experts through the Big Brass wringer. Tonight's topics are Iron Maiden, Apocalypse Now, Stranger Things, and Microsoft PowerPoint!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Class Clowns
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 In English class our teams must perform original poems based on real high school experiences. Next it's Sports Day, where our comedians must compete in a tug-of-war battle against various teams of kids.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Crime Night!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 Episode 5 Julia Zemiro, David Bartlett, Danielle Reynald, Alexei Toliopoulos, Alex Ward and guest Rachael Brown explore our obsession with 'Crime-tainment' and why we find real-life crime so entertaining.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E2 Let The Games Begin As a new chief of staff takes over, rumours intensify that County will be forced to close because of budget cuts. Carol considers selling her house to deal with her financial problems. Jeanie keeps her HIV status a secret.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E2 Escape Room As a surprise for Lee's birthday, Lucy invites the family to join them in an escape room. The event proves hard to forget, with Lee handcuffed to a bomb, a 'traitor' in the room, and Toby's work life called into question.

ABCMESydney.au.title: rage Charts ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E302 Episode 302 Count down the hottest chart hits and catch up on some of the most promising new popular music videos on rage.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E4 MI5 is asked to intervene when the latest round of Middle East peace talks is abruptly halted after a key delegate disappears.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Penn & Teller: Fool Us
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E12 The Eight Stooges Featured magicians include Jack Kelly, Mortenn Christiansen, Robin Sheikh and Magic Samk.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee (NZ)
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E7 You Lost Me At, \ Ben Hurley, Rhiannon McCall, Jacquie Brown and our reigning champ from episode four try to take each other down with their varied spelling knowledge. Guy throws at them games like: Flags, A Decent Proposal and Social Media.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E7 Horrible This episode of QI is a wholesale homage to all that is 'horrible'. Joining QI Master Stephen Fry are panellists Alan Davies, Dara O'Briain, Sean Lock and Chris Addison.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E2 The Eyes An exhausted Finn and Jake are creeped out by an odd-looking horse that mysteriously appears outside the treehouse and keeps them awake.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E13 Fiesta Day The Bears party it up with a living pinatas for Fiesta Day. Wanting the festivities to never end, Grizz wishes for it to be Fiesta Day everyday.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E33 Don't Be an Icarus Robin tries to tell some Greek myths, but the other Titans give their own fractured versions instead.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E35 Derby Dollies When Bubbles joins the Derbytantes, Buttercup finds herself on the sidelines.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E16 Frightningale A young American singer gets akumatized into Frightningale. Armed with a magic mike, she wants to turn Paris into a giant musical. Ladybug and Cat Noir will have to keep the rhythm if they want to stop her!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E20 The Chamber The pressure is on for Gwen when Felicity suddenly gets stage fright! Meanwhile, Ruth and Susan's hard work comes to fruition when they make an amazing discovery before Mr Murray reveals his true colours.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Odd Squad
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E61 Extreme Cake-over Otis and Olympia accidently release a virus that turns agents into cakes.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E17 Beehive The Bears allow bees to live in the cave to make honey.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E11 The Band Bored during a rainy little lunch, Atticus starts a band and makes Battie reluctantly join too.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E20 Brave the Wave Ash challenges the Dewford Gym, but Gym Leader Brawly seems more interested in surfing!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 Disarmed Robby, Mo, and the Terrans attempt to unlock new cyber-sleeve powers, with disastrous results.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E7 In Your Footsteps A bear befriends Finn and Jake, but what are his true intentions?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E52 The Cape The Titans reminisce about when they threw a party for Cinderblock.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E32 Classic Titans Control Freak sends the Titans to a former version of the team.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E22 The Stars When Dad gives Larry's hairdresser a bad review for saying he's bald, he gets offered a free haircut. This inspires Gumball and Darwin to go on a reviewing spree across town.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E32 Faking It It's been ages since their last quest and the heroes are losing their edge, so Friendlyface sends the heroes on a fake quest to get rid of a monster.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E51 Submarine Jim, Part 1 The sub is stolen by pirates after they set a trap. Unable to find a solution, Jim accepts Cyril's proposal: to defrost Roy using an extraordinary human invention.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E16 Ant We All Just Get Along Owen and Beth try to save an ant hill that Courtney and Leshawna want to destroy.

syfy.us.title: The Rock
syfy.us.description: FBI chemical warfare expert Stanley Goodspeed (Nicolas Cage) is sent on an urgent mission with a former British spy, John Patrick Mason (Sean Connery), to stop Gen. Francis X. Hummel (Ed Harris) from launching chemical weapons on Alcatraz Island into San Francisco. Gen. Hummel demands $100 million in war reparations to be paid to the families of slain servicemen who died on covert operations. After their SEAL team is wiped out, Stanley and John deal with the soldiers on their own. (Action) - 1996

syfy.us.title: Gone in 60 Seconds
syfy.us.description: Randall "Memphis" Raines long ago abandoned his life of crime, but after an ominous visit from an old friend, he finds he has no choice but to return to what he does best -- stealing cars -- in order to save his brother's life. It all comes down to one night, 50 cars and a contract. (Action, Thriller) - 2000

syfy.us.title: Con Air
syfy.us.description: Just-paroled army ranger Cameron Poe (Nicolas Cage) is headed back to his wife (Monica Potter), but must fly home aboard a prison transport flight dubbed "Jailbird" with some of the worst criminals living. Along with Diamond Dog (Ving Rhames) and Baby-O (Mykelti Williamson), genius serial killer Cyrus "The Virus" Grissom (John Malkovich) unleashes a violent escape plot in mid-flight. Secretly working with U.S. Marshal Vince Larkin (John Cusack), Poe tries to foil Grissom's plan. (Action) - 1997

syfy.us.title: Fright Night
syfy.us.description: Charley (Anton Yelchin) is a high-school senior who's in with the "in" crowd and dating Amy (Imogen Poots), the most sought-after gal on campus. But trouble enters his world in the form of Jerry Dandridge (Colin Farrell), a charismatic new neighbor. After witnessing some unusual activity next door, Charley concludes that Jerry is a vampire. Of course, no one believes him. After seeking advice from illusionist Peter Vincent (David Tennant), Charley sets out to destroy Jerry himself. (Horror, Comedy) - 2011

syfy.us.title: The Twilight Zone - The Last Night of a Jockey

syfy.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Night Call

nbcuniverso.us.title: Acércate a Rocío
nbcuniverso.us.description: Hablar de los problemas es el primer paso para superarlos y, por eso, Rocío trae un programa único para hablar de las preocupaciones de cada día y, en conjunto, encontrar una solución. (Talk Shows, Lifestyle)

nbcuniverso.us.title: El final del paraíso - La pelea final
nbcuniverso.us.description: Albeiro y Titi descargan todo el odio y fuerza acumulados. Al mismo tiempo, el equipo de la Diabla pone en marcha el supuesto operativo para rescatar al niño en manos de la Cuina y Pilar. (Soaps, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Vividora con derecho; Primero muerto que deshabilitado
nbcuniverso.us.description: El papá cobró una indemnización porque su hija se perdió en el terminal y la mamá exige el dinero. Andrea quiere que su esposo se declare inhabilitado por un problema en la pierna, pero él se niega. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Odio de sangre; Falsas ayudas

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Último día de Felicia; Arresto domiciliario

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Enséñame humildad

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Lazos recuperados

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

wrsp.us.title: Storm of Suspicion
wrsp.us.description: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Dr. Elizabeth Austin, a forensic meteorologist who has worked on countless cases in which weather and crime go hand in hand plays a part in the series. (Crime, Reality, Weather) - 2018-10-07

discoverywest.us.title: Ghost Adventures

discoverywest.us.title: Ghost Adventures

discoverywest.us.title: Ghost Adventures
discoverywest.us.description: Abandoned in Elko The crew awaken hostile spirits in Nevada when they investigate the Commercial Hotel and Casino; the building's rough history of lawless cowboys, cutthroat gamblers and exploited women fuels a malevolent energy.

discoverywest.us.title: Ghost Adventures
discoverywest.us.description: Terror in Tempe Zak and the crew are called to Tempe, Ariz., to investigate a brewery awash with dark and disturbing paranormal activity; the team lands in the crosshairs of dueling entities as they dig deep into the colossal factory's troubled past.

discoverywest.us.title: Ghost Adventures
discoverywest.us.description: Hotel San Carlos The crew peels back the glamorous façade of a Phoenix, Ariz., hotel to expose a darkness that's said to drive people mad; the team encounters a demonic presence that could be responsible for countless deaths on the property.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Files
discoverywest.us.description: S03 E02 Madness Explained Was witchcraft at work during the Salem witch trials, or an undiagnosed psychological illness?; did Britain's famous UFO sighting by officials have a more earthly explanation?; who's really responsible for the murder of the Mad Monk of Russia?

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Files
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E12 Smoke and Mirrors Josh Gates explores how new evidence reshapes history's mysteries: a fresh analysis of Edgar Allan Poe's death; a novel take on Ponce de León's quest for the Fountain of Youth.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Files
discoverywest.us.description: S03 E03 Time Reveals All A body is found on a beach with only a cryptic note; the Trojan War and the Trojan Horse were once thought to be pure myth, but the discovery of ruins reveals they were all too real; new evidence may prove Shakespeare didn't write his own works.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Files
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E04 Under Pressure Josh Gates reopens cases where the truth stayed buried -- he exposes new clues, alibis and revelations that challenge everything that we thought we know about Noah's Ark, the terror of anthrax attacks and Bugsy Siegel's murder.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Files
discoverywest.us.description: S04 E06 Fact or Fiction? Josh Gates investigates Dracula, Cold War psychic spying and Spartacus; from Vlad the Impaler's infamous reign of terror, to secret U.S. mind-control tests and a gladiator who defied Rome.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Unknown
discoverywest.us.description: S17 E03 Death Jars of Laos Deep in the Laos jungle, Josh must detonate Vietnam War bombs before searching for a lost culture's burial jars; 3D scanning and facial recognition could expose this mysterious civilization.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Unknown
discoverywest.us.description: S17 E04 Sunken City of Pirates A survey reveals a submerged pirate lair located off the coast of Jamaica; using photogrammetry, Josh dives in to hunt for the $50M stolen treasure of Black Bart, the King of Pirates.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Unknown
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E04 Hunting Vampires Josh explores the history of vampirism in Romania and Bulgaria.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Unknown

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Unknown
discoverywest.us.description: S06 E03 Mysteries of Jesus Josh Gates journeys to the Holy Land to find out where Jesus was born; his investigation leads to potentially explosive revelations that may change people's understanding of Jesus' origin story.

fxm.us.title: Don't Breathe 2
fxm.us.description: Blind veteran Norman Nordstrom has been hiding out for several years in an isolated cabin. He lives with a young girl and has recreated the family stolen from him by a drunken driver. Their quiet life together is soon shattered when a group of unseemly criminals kidnaps her. Norman is now forced to tap into even darker and more creative instincts in an effort to save her. (Thriller, Horror, Action, Crime drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: Antebellum
fxm.us.description: Successful author Veronica Henley is finishing a book tour before she returns home to her husband and daughter. But a shocking turn of events is about to upend Veronica's existence, plunging her into a horrifying reality that forces her to confront her past, present and future -- before it's too late. (Thriller) - 2020

fxm.us.title: Race With the Devil
fxm.us.description: Roger (Peter Fonda), his friend Frank (Warren Oates), and their wives (Lara Parker, Loretta Swit) are heading from San Antonio to the wilderness of rural Texas for some off-road motocross. What they find instead is a Satanic cult sacrifice, and they are unfortunate enough to be caught observing the ritual. Naturally, this doesn't sit too well with the cult members. Now Roger and Frank are on the run from what is apparently a very sizable Texan Satanist community. (Horror) - 1975

fxm.us.title: Wizards
fxm.us.description: After the death of his mother, the evil mutant wizard Blackwolf (Steve Gravers) discovers some long-lost military technologies. Full of ego and ambition, Blackwolf claims his mother's throne, assembles an army and sets out to brainwash and conquer Earth. Meanwhile, Blackwolf's gentle twin brother, the bearded and sage Avatar (Bob Holt), calls upon his own magical abilities to foil Blackwolf's plans for world domination -- even if it means destroying his own flesh and blood. (Animated, Fantasy) - 1977

fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Curse of the Fly
fxm.us.description: Scantily clad Patricia Stanley (Carole Gray) breaks out of a mental hospital and is picked up by passing motorist Martin Delambre (George Baker). The two do not reveal much about themselves to each other, but nevertheless decide to get married. At the Delambre family mansion, Patricia meets Martin's father, Henri (Brian Donlevy), an eccentric scientist. Snooping about the grounds, she discovers evidence of the family's strange experiments in teleportation and the grisly results thereof. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery, Drama) - 1965

fxm.us.title: Witchcraft
fxm.us.description: For generations, the Whitlocks and the Laniers have been feuding, including when Vanessa Whitlock (Yvette Rees), accused of being a witch, was buried alive centuries ago. Now Bill Lanier (Jack Hedley) wants to dig up a burial ground for development purposes, and Morgan Whitlock (Lon Chaney Jr.) tries to stop him. Soon, unexplainable accidents start to happen to members of the Lanier family, throwing suspicion on Morgan. The real truth Bill discovers is much more sinister than he expected. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Horror of It All
fxm.us.description: Yankee salesman Jack (Pat Boone) wants to marry Cynthia Marley (Erica Rogers), and they travel to her family's English estate to break the good news. Cynthia warns that the family is a bit odd, which proves to be an understatement. One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. But things get really sinister when the Marleys start succumbing to violent fates, one by one. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Young Frankenstein
fxm.us.description: Respected medical lecturer Dr. Frederick Frankenstein (Gene Wilder) learns that he has inherited his infamous grandfather's estate in Transylvania. Arriving at the castle, Dr. Frankenstein soon begins to recreate his grandfather's experiments with the help of servants Igor (Marty Feldman), Inga (Teri Garr) and the fearsome Frau Blücher (Cloris Leachman). After he creates his own monster (Peter Boyle), new complications ensue with the arrival of the doctor's fiancée, Elizabeth (Madeline Kahn). (Comedy) - 1974

fxm.us.title: The Unholy
fxm.us.description: A girl inexplicably gains the power to heal the sick after a supposed visitation from the Virgin Mary. As word spreads and people flock to witness her miracles, a disgraced journalist visits the small New England town to investigate. However, when strange events start to occur, he soon wonders if these phenomena are the result of something more sinister. (Horror, Thriller) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Happening
fxm.us.description: An apocalyptic threat to humanity arrives out of the clear blue sky with a series of violent, inexplicable deaths spreading across the country. 5starmax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
5starmax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Man
5starmax.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

5starmax.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography) - 1985

Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Ricochet
5starmax.us.description: After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (Action) - 1991

5starmax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
5starmax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Open Water
5starmax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. 5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11

bbcamerica.us.title: Ghost Ship
bbcamerica.us.description: In a remote region of the Bering Sea, a boat salvage crew discovers the eerie remains of a grand passenger liner thought lost for more than 40 years. But once onboard the eerie, cavernous ship, the crew of the Arctic Warrior discovers that the decaying vessel is anything but deserted. It's home to something more deadly and horrific than anything they've encountered in all their years at sea. (Horror, Thriller) - 2002

bbcamerica.us.title: Trick 'r Treat
bbcamerica.us.description: Interwoven stories demonstrate that some traditions are best not forgotten as the residents (Anna Paquin, Brian Cox, Dylan Baker) of a small town face real ghosts and goblins on Halloween. Tales of terror reveal the consequences of extinguishing a Jack-o-Lantern before midnight and a grumpy hermit's encounter with a sinister trick-or-treater. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2007

bbcamerica.us.title: Creepshow
bbcamerica.us.description: A compendium of five short but terrifying tales contained within a single full-length feature, this film conjures scares from traditional bogeymen and portents of doom. In one story, a monster escapes from its holding cell. Another focuses on a husband (Leslie Nielsen) with a creative way of getting back at his cheating wife. Other stories concern a rural man (Stephen King) and a visitor from outer space, and a homeowner (E.G. Marshall) with huge bug problems and a boozing corpse. (Horror, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1982

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - I.D.
bbcamerica.us.description: The detectives investigate a case involving a woman who was killed for her identity by her own sister. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-09-25

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Good Girl
bbcamerica.us.description: A young woman of Italian descent changes her story when her fingerprints turn up at the apartment of a murdered black college student. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-10-02

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Survivor
bbcamerica.us.description: In a twisting, turning whodunit, Briscoe and Curtis (Jerry Orbach, Benjamin Bratt) investigate the murder of a rare-coin dealer. With Sam Waterston, Carey Lowell, S. Epatha Merkerson and Steven Hill. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-10-23

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Corruption
bbcamerica.us.description: A crooked cop testifies against Briscoe after the detectives are involved in a botched drug-bust leading to a drug-dealer's death. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-10-30

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Double Blind
bbcamerica.us.description: A mentally ill college student participating in experimental drug research becomes a suspect in a janitor's murder. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-11-06

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Deadbeat
bbcamerica.us.description: Briscoe and Curtis investigate the murder of an underhanded used-car salesman who was wanted for unpaid child support. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-11-13

bbcamerica.us.title: Wild Patagonia - Heat and Dust
bbcamerica.us.description: Follows the path of a relentless wind from the Andes' peaks, that sweeps east through Patagonia's dry desert; the world of maras and desert-dwelling penguins; the first faltering steps of baby guanacos. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2015-10-02

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - Mountains
bbcamerica.us.description: Touring the mightiest mountain ranges. (Science, Educational, Documentary, Nature, History) - 2006-03-12

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - Seasonal Forests
bbcamerica.us.description: The trees of the Taiga forest; giant sequoia, the largest living thing on the planet. (Science, Educational, Documentary, Nature, History) - 2006-12-03

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - From Pole to Pole
bbcamerica.us.description: Traveling around the Earth, finding where the sun always shines and where it's rarely seen; finding where water is abundant and where it's scarce. (Science, Educational, Documentary, Nature, History) - 2006-03-05

bbcamerica.us.title: Land of the Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt. (Horror) - 2005

bbcamerica.us.title: Shaun of the Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: Shaun is a 30-something loser with a dull, easy existence. When he's not working at the electronics store, he lives with his slovenly best friend, Ed, in a small flat on the outskirts of London. The only unpredictable element in his life is his girlfriend, Liz, who wishes desperately for Shaun to grow up and be a man. When the town is inexplicably overrun with zombies, Shaun must rise to the occasion and protect both Liz and his mother. (Comedy, Horror) - 2004

bbcamerica.us.title: Army of Darkness
bbcamerica.us.description: 3rd Evil Dead movie. Ash finds himself trapped in medieval times. He must quest for the Necronomicon, a book of evil which can return him to his time. Unfortunately, he releases the evil trapped inside the book and unleashes an army of the dead. (Fantasy, Adventure, Horror, Comedy) - 1992

bbcamerica.us.title: The Return of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: When foreman Frank (James Karen) shows new employee Freddy (Thom Mathews) a secret military experiment in a supply warehouse, the two klutzes accidentally release a gas that reanimates corpses into flesh-eating zombies. As the epidemic spreads throughout Louisville, Ky., and the creatures satisfy their hunger in gory and outlandish ways, Frank and Freddy fight to survive with the help of their boss (Clu Gulager) and a mysterious mortician (Don Calfa). (Horror, Comedy) - 1985

bbcamerica.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely. (Horror) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary
bbcamerica.us.description: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient. (Horror, Thriller) - 1989

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary Two
bbcamerica.us.description: A teen (Edward Furlong) and his buddy take a shot-dead dog to a sacred burial ground where it comes back to life, riled. - 1992

bouncetv.us.title: The Best Man
bouncetv.us.description: After writing a soon-to-be bestselling novel, writer and committed bachelor Harper Stewart (Taye Diggs) attempts to hide the fact that his saucy new book is loosely based on the lives and loves of his tight-knit group of friends. Harper is set to be the best man at his friend Lance's (Morris Chestnut) wedding, and all his friends will be in attendance. When an advance copy of the book makes its way into the hands of his ex-flame, Jordan Armstrong (Nia Long), Harper attempts to keep it under wraps. (Comedy drama) - 1999

bouncetv.us.title: Tyler Perry's Why Did I Get Married?
bouncetv.us.description: Eight married friends take their annual reunion vacation in the Colorado mountains. Revelations of infidelity involving one pair shatter the amicable mood, forcing the remaining friends to take a hard look at the strength of their own marriages. The couples grapple with issues of commitment, love, betrayal and forgiveness as they try to move on with their lives. (Comedy drama) - 2007

bouncetv.us.title: Tyler Perry's Why Did I Get Married Too?
bouncetv.us.description: In the Bahamas for their annual reunion, four couples are eager to share news about their lives over the past year. But when one's ex-husband arrives to break up her marriage and win her back, the others realize they are not immune to the challenges of love and fidelity. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2010

bouncetv.us.title: Norbit
bouncetv.us.description: Mild-mannered Norbit (Eddie Murphy) has always had it rough, since the day he was left abandoned at a combination Chinese restaurant and orphanage. Recently forced to marry the shrewish glutton Rasputia, he is at wit's end. Then his childhood sweetheart, Kate (Thandie Newton), moves back to town, and he tries to figure out a way back to his true love. (Comedy, Romance) - 2007

bouncetv.us.title: Love Jones
bouncetv.us.description: Two urban African-Americans, Darius (Larenz Tate), an aspiring writer, and Nina (Nia Long), an aspiring photographer, share an instant connection after a chance meeting at a Chicago club. The two bond over music, photography and poetry, and eventually begin a torrid romance. However, when Nina decides to move to New York and mend her relationship with her ex-fiancé, Marvin (Khalil Kain), it leaves Darius heartbroken, and the couple's future in jeopardy. (Romance, LGBTQ) - 1997

cinesony.us.title: Saving Silverman

cinesony.us.description: Michael Harding regresa a casa de la escuela militar y se encuentra a su madre felizmente enamorada y viviendo con su nuevo novio, David. A medida que los dos hombres van conociéndose, Michael sospecha que David esconde un oscuro secreto. (Movies, Thriller) - 2009

cinesony.us.title: Grandma

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04
