retroplex.us.title: Dressed to Kill
retroplex.us.description: Holmes and Watson hunt for three music boxes containing directions to the whereabouts of six valuable engraving plates stolen from the Bank of England. They find themselves in competition with professional thieves also out to find the clues, which were hidden by a spiteful jailbird before the music boxes went up for auction. (Mystery) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Woman in Green
retroplex.us.description: When a number of attractive women are found dead and with fingers missing, Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) investigate. Though evidence points to a psychotic killer, Holmes begins to believe that there's more to the case than initially meets the eye, a notion that leads him to uncover the involvement of his archenemy, Professor Moriarty (Henry Daniell). Who is working with Moriarty on such a dastardly plot, and what are their motives? (Mystery) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
retroplex.us.description: Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) saves noted Swiss physicist Franz Tobel (William Post Jr.) from the Gestapo in Zurich and smuggles him to London. There, Tobel is reunited with his wife, Charlotte (Kaaren Verne), to whom he gives a coded message in the event he disappears. Tobel presents the weapon he developed to government officials, and when he is subsequently abducted by arch-villain Professor Moriarty (Lionel Atwill), Holmes and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) risk their lives to find him. (Mystery) - 1942

retroplex.us.title: Rimfire
retroplex.us.description: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Shotgun
retroplex.us.description: A deputy sheriff (Sterling Hayden) seeks justice with a woman (Yvonne De Carlo), a bounty hunter (Zachary Scott) and a sawed-off shotgun. (Western) - 1955

retroplex.us.title: The Proud Rebel
retroplex.us.description: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault — and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland). (Western) - 1958

Tolkien classic, "The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King" presents the final confrontation between the forces of good and evil fighting for control of the future of Middle-earth. Hobbits Frodo and Sam reach Mordor in their quest to destroy the `one ring', while Aragorn leads the forces of good against Sauron's evil army at the stone city of Minas Tirith. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

Though she's come into her full powers, she maintains a low profile by curating ancient artifacts, and only performing heroic acts incognito. But soon, Diana will have to muster all of her strength, wisdom and courage as she finds herself squaring off against Maxwell Lord and the Cheetah, a villainess who possesses superhuman strength and agility. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2020

bbcearth.us.description: S02 E05 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on nature's most amazing animals; he takes a closer look at the vampire bat.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Life on Ice
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E07 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on the wood frog, which freezes solid; he looks at how the emperor penguin breeds.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Spinners and Weavers
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E08 Nature produces two unique mechanisms of natural construction; weaving in birds and silk fascinate scientists.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Strange Parents
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E09 David Attenborough shines the spotlight on female hyenas; he examines why male seahorses give birth.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Magical Appearances
bbcearth.us.description: The disappearance of some animals each year puzzled early naturalists; the question arises whether swallows hibernate in mud or underwater and the sudden appearance of butterflies each spring was also a mystery.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Impossible Feats
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E01 David Attenborough examines how fleas jump; he tracks the true speed of a cheetah.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Minds
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E02 David Attenborough examines orangutans and crows, two unusual animals that use tools.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Expandable Bodies
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E03 David Attenborough examines creatures that have fascinated people for centuries; he looks at the expandable bodies of anacondas and camels.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Feeders
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E04 A look at some species with unusual styles of consuming food, including the gigantic blue whales and the flamboyant flamingos.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Cures
bbcearth.us.description: Humans are not alone in using medicines against injuries and infection and some animals protect themselves with natural remedies in extraordinary ways.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Remarkable Regeneration
bbcearth.us.description: A look at the animals who can regenerate entire parts of their bodies.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Caribbean

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico

bbcearth.us.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Forests of the Maya The ancient temples of the Maya still tower over the forests of the Yucatán, where jaguars, monkeys and tropical birds make their home; it is a forest full of secrets, with a vast watery underworld.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Burning North A feature on the forces behind Mexico's driest region, and the animals overcoming its conditions.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Chocolate Chef Raymond Blanc creates four mouth-watering chocolate recipes: a simple mousse, rich chocolate delice, fondant with a melting middle, and his signature dessert: café crème, which is a chocolate-sculpted cup filled with a mousse and coffee sabayon.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Fish Raymond dives into the world of fish with the underused and affordable mackerel; he creates a light meal of grilled mackerel with a soy lime dressing.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Apples Chef Raymond Blanc looks to the UK's favorite fruit, apples, for inspiration; he returns to memories of childhood with a simple tart made with a foolproof pastry and custard filling.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Winter Vegetables Chef Blanc celebrates the season with a winter vegetable salad featuring beetroots, a celeriac purée served with a crisp-skinned roast wild duck with blackberry sauce and watercress soup.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Game and Mushrooms Chef Blanc uses two seasonal ingredients, game and mushrooms, to create a French version of a pasty called pithivier, which is filled with a rich mix of pheasant, chestnuts and dried fruits; he also makes a cep mushroom tortellini with fresh pasta.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bread The miracle of yeast helps Raymond to create a French classic: brioche; he gets down to basics with a French country bread recipe that's essential for any baker to add to their repertoire; lastly, he makes a spectacular apple croustade.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Eggs and Cheese Chef Raymond Blanc combines the universally popular ingredients of egg and cheese to make a classic omelette with a secret technique; he then uses a Comte from his home region in France to make a family-style souffle.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Tomatoes Chef Blanc focuses on tomatoes, opening with a simple salad recipe inspired by his mother; he also makes a creamy risotto, stuffed tomatoes glazed with cheese and a series of ices and sorbets to cleanse the palate with elegance.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 San Francisco to Monterey Rick enjoys sitting on the dock of the bay in San Francisco, tasting legendary dishes like the hangtown fry; San Francisco is also the home of sourdough and where America's love affair with seasonal cooking took hold.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Monterey to San Diego Rick Stein continues traveling down the Californian coastline immortalized by Steinbeck.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 San Diego to Baja California Rick enjoys a hearty steak and eggs American diner special and bids a fond farewell to his trusty Ford Mustang as he heads across what is reputed to be the busiest border crossing in the world.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Rick lands in the town that gave the world tequila and the metropolis that birthed mariachis and dishes like chili con carne.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mexico City to Oaxaca Rick Stein visits the Mexican capital to sample the Aztec cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Oaxaca to Chinantlan Mountains Rick Stein's latest travels take him to Mexico's culinary capital Oaxaca.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Oaxaca to Yucatan Peninsula Rick Stein heads east from Oaxaca to the Yucatán Peninsula, a place once frequented by real pirates of the Caribbean, including Sir Francis Drake.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nisha's family helps her cook chicken dhansak and a Hungarian favorite.

cinevault.us.title: Darkness Falls
cinevault.us.description: In Maine, the residents of Darkness Falls are all aware of the legend of Matilda Dixon, an old woman who was tragically murdered by a mob in the 1800s because the townspeople thought she was killing children. Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2003-01-24

cinevault.us.title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
cinevault.us.description: The Rev. Moore is prosecuted for the wrongful death of a girl thought to be demonically possessed, because he administered the church-sanctioned exorcism that ultimately killed her. Prosecuting attorney Ethan Thomas contends that the young woman, Emily, suffered from schizophrenia and should have been medically diagnosed. Meanwhile, defense lawyer Erin Bruner argues that Emily's condition cannot be explained by science alone. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-09-09

cinevault.us.title: Lakeview Terrace
cinevault.us.description: An uptight cop (Samuel L. Jackson), the self-appointed watchdog of his neighborhood, strongly disapproves of the interracial newlyweds (Patrick Wilson, Kerry Washington) who just moved in next door. He becomes increasingly hostile toward the innocent pair, going to great lengths to force them out of their home. The situation changes when the young couple decide to fight back. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-09-19

cinevault.us.title: The Art of War
cinevault.us.description: He is both agent and weapon - a critical line of defense for the Secretary General of the United Nations. He does not even officially exist. Neil Shaw, an American agent who must uncover an international plot to bring down the United Nations on the eve of an historic summit with China. A mysterious chain of events leads to the murder of the Chinese U.N. Ambassador. When Shaw is accused of the crime, he must go underground -- in effect, vanish from his own life. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2000-08-23

cinevault.us.title: Ike: Countdown to D-Day

cinevault.us.title: Sahara

cinevault.us.title: 7 Seconds

cinevault.us.title: Family Business
cinevault.us.description: Vito (Dustin Hoffman) is the son of Jessie (Sean Connery), a professional criminal who has trained his son in the craft. With the birth of his own son, Adam (Matthew Broderick), Vito decides to reform his life. When he's in college, Adam's family's shady lifestyle seduces him, and with the help of his grandfather, he plans an elaborate burglary for the family to pull off together. dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - A Walk in the Rain
dateline.us.description: The disappearance of 19-year-old Alaska Native Sonya Ivanoff sends shockwaves through the small coastal city of Nome, Alaska; police scramble to find answers until a note is found in a stolen police vehicle telling the cops to back off or else.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Good & Evil

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Devil in Disguise

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Manson

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Evil That Watches

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gerry
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed. (Drama) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Animal Factory
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid. (Drama, Crime drama) - 2000

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Killing Season
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A U.S. veteran (Robert De Niro) and a former Serbian soldier (John Travolta) play cat-and-mouse games in the remote wilderness. (Thriller, Action) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

outlaw.us.description: A scout (Rod Cameron) leads a wagon train through territory made hostile by a violated treaty. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: The First Texan
outlaw.us.description: Having left his post as governor of Tennessee, Gen. Sam Houston (Joel McCrea) resettles in Mexican territory along the southwest U.S. border. He soon sets his sights on reclaiming the land under the aegis of Texas independence, while romancing post-divorce new love interest Katherine Delaney (Felicia Farr). His efforts eventually lead to the historic Battle of San Jacinto and a very clever bit of battlefield strategy by Houston in his fight against forces led by Gen. Santa Anna. (Western) - 1956

outlaw.us.title: They Died With Their Boots On
outlaw.us.description: George Armstrong Custer (Errol Flynn) is a rebellious but ambitious soldier, eager to join the Civil War. During the war, Custer has numerous successes to his credit, even though he disobeys orders. After the war concludes, he marries Libby Bacon (Olivia de Havilland) and is assigned to the Dakota Territory. Custer negotiates honestly with the Sioux on land, but due to corruption from others, a battle with Sitting Bull's forces occurs at Little Big Horn. (Western) - 1941

outlaw.us.title: Riding Shotgun
outlaw.us.description: Larry Delong loses his sister and her son when they're gunned down by the notorious Dan Marady and his band of outlaws during a holdup. Delong takes a job as a stagecoach guard, hoping to run into the bandits and take revenge. Run into them, he does, but numbers are on Marady's side, and they shoot up and rob Delong's coach. Delong barely escapes with his life. When he tries to alert the authorities, they implicate him in the crime, and he becomes a fugitive. (Western) - 1954

outlaw.us.title: Wild Rovers
outlaw.us.description: Tired of his job at a ranch owned by Walter Buckman (Karl Malden), Frank Post (Ryan O'Neal) wants to pull a heist, and when his much older coworker, Ross Bodine (William Holden), sees nothing better on the horizon, the cowboys agree to team up for the crime. After filling their pockets with loot from a local bank, Frank and Ross ride toward what they hope is freedom. But the younger Buckmans, Paul (Joe Don Baker) and John (Tom Skerritt), pursue them over the rough land of the Southwest. (Western) - 1971

outlaw.us.title: They Died With Their Boots On
outlaw.us.description: George Armstrong Custer (Errol Flynn) is a rebellious but ambitious soldier, eager to join the Civil War. outtvproud.us.title: Jackie's Back!
outtvproud.us.description: A British documentarian (Tim Curry) profiles a washed-up diva (Jenifer Lewis) as she prepares for her comeback concert. (Comedy) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Cruel Intentions
outtvproud.us.description: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed. (Drama) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Lord of Illusions
outtvproud.us.description: Private eye Harry D'Amour travels to Los Angeles and meets with a new client, Dorothea Swann. Swann reveals that she and her husband — famed magician Philip Swann — have been targeted by a religious cult experimenting with reincarnation. After Philip dies on stage in the midst of a dangerous trick, D'Amour must struggle to protect Dorothea from the ruthless cult members and their newly reanimated religious leader, Nix. (Horror) - 1995

outtvproud.us.title: Troll 2
outtvproud.us.description: When young Joshua (Michael Stephenson) learns that he will be going on vacation with his family to a small town called Nilbog, he protests adamantly. He is warned by the spirit of his deceased grandfather that goblins populate the town. His parents, Michael (George Hardy) and Diana (Margo Prey), dismiss his apprehensions, but soon learn to appreciate their son's warnings. Guided by his grandfather's ghost, will Joshua and his family stand a chance in fighting off these evil beings? (Horror, Comedy) - 1990

outtvproud.us.title: Night of the Comet
outtvproud.us.description: After a rare comet sighting, teen sisters Regina (Catherine Mary Stewart) and Samantha (Kelli Maroney) find that they're among the only survivors of a zombie attack. The girls partner with another survivor, Hector (Robert Beltran), but as they try to avoid the zombies, they're sought by scientists who want to experiment on their bodies in the hope of finding an antidote. Dodging both the doctors and the undead, they keep moving in the hope that they can continue to stay alive. (Science fiction, Comedy, Horror) - 1984

outtvproud.us.title: Bug
outtvproud.us.description: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair. (Drama, Thriller, Horror) - 2006

outtvproud.us.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
outtvproud.us.description: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 1993

outtvproud.us.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
outtvproud.us.description: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good. (Fantasy, Comedy, Romance) - 1991

outtvproud.us.title: Coming Soon

However, Stream wants more than just her first sexual experience. She wants to have an orgasm -- but achieving this proves problematic, as the boys she meets are hardly sensitive enough to provide her the release she seeks. When it becomes clear that Nell and Jenny have never experienced an orgasm either, all three set out to get one. (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ) - 1999

Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. truehistory.us.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin - Benjamin Franklin's Boston Beginnings
truehistory.us.description: One may associate Franklin with Philadelphia, but his roots lie in Boston; many of the virtues Franklin cultivates throughout his life grow from the values of the Boston Puritans; witnessing the events that Franklin experiences in his youth. (American history) - 2018-03-02

truehistory.us.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin - Benjamin Franklin and Philadelphia

(American history) - 2018-03-02

truehistory.us.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA - Secrecy, Democracy, and the Birth of the CIA
truehistory.us.description: Why the United States created a secret foreign intelligence service; examining three periods of U.S. government intelligence before the birth of the CIA; the American Revolution to the late 1930s; World War II; the postwar years from 1945 to 1947. (American history) - 2019-03-01

truehistory.us.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA - George Kennan and the Rise of Covert Ops
truehistory.us.description: How the CIA transformed from an intelligence agency to housing the United States' premier covert-action unit in the space of just two years; the role of George F. Kennan, who declared political warfare against the Soviet Union. (American history) - 2019-03-01

truehistory.us.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA - The CIA, China, and the Korean War
truehistory.us.description: The CIA's attention to Asia; how the CIA failed to rein in its emphasis on covert operations and restore its focus on intelligence; a lack of public scrutiny of the CIA's actions; the arrival of future CIA director Allen Dulles. (American history) - 2019-03-01

truehistory.us.title: The Agency: A History of the CIA - The Iran Coup of August 1953
truehistory.us.description: The 1953 Iran Coup and how it created a culture of covert action that would shape the CIA's future; studying the shifting political attitudes toward Iranian nationalism; analyzing the Iran operation; pondering who was most responsible. (American history) - 2019-03-01

truehistory.us.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy - Westward the Course of Empire
truehistory.us.description: Some of the ways people think about the American West; how this vast, fascinating region comes into being; how it is shaped by centuries of myth-making; what about westward expansion fascinates every generation of Americans. (American history) - 2017-08-18

truehistory.us.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy - The West in the Colonial Era
truehistory.us.description: Understanding the mark left on the American West by its earliest colonists; the Spaniards, who introduce horses; the French, who develop a complex trade system; the English, who have little interest in colonizing the west of the Appalachians. (American history) - 2017-08-18

truehistory.us.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy - Venturing Beyond the Appalachians
truehistory.us.description: After the Revolutionary War, the land between the Appalachians and the Mississippi becomes part of the new republic; how the territory is organized; the Northwest Ordinance of 1787 creates a new set of rules that clashes with old realities. (American history) - 2017-08-18

truehistory.us.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy - Discoveries of Lewis and Clark
truehistory.us.description: The journey of the two explorers who map the Louisiana Purchase between 1804 and 1806; how Lewis and Clark fit into the tradition of explorers looking for a water route to the Pacific; the political and geographic history of the Louisiana Purchase. (American history) - 2017-08-18

(World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.description: The origins of World War II lie in Asia in 1931; tracing the invasion of 1937 and the Rape of Nanjing; witnessing the events through the eyes of a Chinese soldier and a Japanese journalist, young men who bear witness to the flesh and blood of battle. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - Panzer Leaders Who Changed Warfare
truehistory.us.description: In addition to the story of people, World War II is the story of technology; perhaps nowhere is this more apparent than the tanks Germany uses to barrel across Poland and France in "lightning warfare"; how new technology defeats the old ways of war. unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : The Coca-Cola Woods

waypointtv.us.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within : North American Deer Slam- Giant Mexican Texanus Whitetail

waypointtv.us.title: The Journey Within : The Journey Within - Eastern Cape of South Africa: Vaal Reedbuck

waypointtv.us.title: The Bearded Buck : Home, Sweet Home
waypointtv.us.description: After starting turkey season off on the road, it's time for us to come back home to Pennsylvania and hunt some turkeys on our home turf! Joining us this week are our good friends from The Grind Outdoors who come in to hunt some long beards with us.

classica.us.description: Zwei italienische Pianisten interpretieren gemeinsam Mozarts Klaviersonate in D für zwei Klaviere, Mendelssohns Klaviersonate für zwei Klaviere in D und Gershwins "Rhapsody in Blue" in einem Konzertprogramm aus dem Fazioli-Saal in Sacile. (Special, Music) - 2021-02-13

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. (Documentary, Music) - 2019

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 7
classica.us.description: Ungewöhnliche Orchesterfarben und -effekte. Die Verwendung seltenerer Instrumente und die frischen Klanglandschaften, die Mahler schafft, führen zu einem reichen und einzigartigen Hörerlebnis. (Special) - 2026-03-21

classica.us.title: Schumann - 2. Klaviersonate in g-Moll, op. 22
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Klaviersonate Nr. 2 in g-Moll, Op. 22. Es beginnt mit einem energischen ersten Satz, gefolgt von einem wunderschönen, langsamen Andantino nach Schumanns Lied "Im Herbste". (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-09

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: IVC 2021 - Finale: Wolf, De Falla, Poulenc u. a
classica.us.description: Sophia Burgos und Daniel Gerzenberg führen "Schweig' einmal still, du garst'ger Schwätzer dort" auf. (Music, Classical) - 2023-09-12

classica.us.title: Prokofjew - Peter und der Wolf
classica.us.description: Das weltberühmte sinfonische Märchen von Sergej Prokofjew wird in einer neuen Interpretation präsentiert. Der Dirigent erzählt die Geschichte auf seine Art und wird dabei vom Britten-Pears Orchester musikalisch unterstützt. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2019-11-16

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Klavierkonzert Nr. 1 und Sinfonie Nr. 2
classica.us.description: Im Alter von sieben Jahren debütierte Martha Argerich mit Ludwig van Beethovens Klavierkonzert Nr. 1. In diesem Konzert beim Luzern Festival spielt die gefeierte Pianistin das berühmte Werk mit dem Luzern Festival Orchester. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-06-10

classica.us.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Halbfinale I: Derek Wang
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Derek Wang tritt mit dem CMIM-Ensemble auf, das aus drei führenden Streichern des Orchestre symphonique de Montréal besteht. Gemeinsam interpretieren sie den ersten Satz, Allegro, aus Johannes Brahms' Klavierquartett Nr. 1 in g-Moll. (Event, Music, Classical) - 2025-03-04

classica.us.title: Im Atelier des Künstlers
classica.us.description: In dieser Serie spielt der Pianist Philippe Cassard in einer Meisterklasse Werke von Claude Debussy. (Event, Music, Classical) - 2021-07-07

classica.us.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26
classica.us.description: Die Sendung zeigt eine Aufführung von Schumanns "Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26". (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-12-12

classica.us.title: Mahler - 4. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Kirill Karabits dirigiert Gustav Mahlers 4. Sinfonie. Als Solistin tritt die Sopranistin Lucy Crowe auf. Seine Vierte Sinfonie beginnt mit Schellenklang, Vogelgezwitscher und einer Melodie, wie direkt aus Mozarts Welt. Alles wirkt wunderbar einfach. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-12-20

classica.us.title: Misha Enzovoort
classica.us.description: Für Misha Mengelberg hat das Vergessen begonnen. Er wartet auf ein Taxi, das er nicht gerufen hat, um zu einem Konzert zu fahren, das nicht stattfindet. Der niederländische Komponist, Pianist und Meister des Jazz Misha Mengelberg, geboren 1935, taucht immer tiefer in das Dunkel der Demenz, die sein Musikerleben beendet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2017-05-19

classica.us.title: Schumann - Sinfonie Nr. 1 in B-Dur
classica.us.description: Der deutsche Dirigent Christian Zacharias leitet das Orchestre national de Lille bei einer Aufführung von Schumanns Sinfonie Nr. 1 in B-Dur, Op. 38. Das Konzert wurde am 16. Juni 2017 im Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-05-03

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - Präludien und Fugen
classica.us.description: Beim 58. Stresa Festival bringt die Compagnia Simona Bucci „Preludi e Fughe: Geografia antropica" auf die Bühne des Teatro Il Maggiore in Verbania. Sieben Tänzer interpretieren ausgewählte Präludien und Fugen op. 87 von Dmitri Schostakowitsch, die ein Pianist live spielt. Choreografin Simona Bucci verbindet Musik und Bewegung zu einer eindrucksvollen Bildsprache. Die Aufführung entsteht im August 2019 und vereint Konzert und Tanz zu einem intensiven Bühnenerlebnis. (Special, Performing arts, Music, Concert) - 2021-08-01

classica.us.title: Mozart - 35. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Der bekannte Dirigent Conrad van Alphen dirigiert die Sinfonia Rotterdam in einer gelungenen Aufführung von Mozarts Sinfonie Nummer 35 D-Dur KV 385. Diese wurde im Jahr 2020 in der Nieuwe Kerk in Den Haag in den Niederlanden aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-06-28

classica.us.title: Cartoons in Concert
classica.us.description: Beliebte Figuren aus der Welt der Cartoons und Animationsfilme treffen im Konzertsaal auf eine mitreißende musikalische Fusion. Gemeinsam mit Chören und Orchestern des DR entsteht ein einzigartiges Konzerterlebnis. Seien Sie gespannt! (Special, Music, Concert) - 2024-12-24

10shakeperth.au.title: PAW Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: When Rocky goes missing, Cap'n Turbot and Francois spot a werepuppy's shadow while stargazing. The team takes the PAW Patroller to a ranch to help Mayor Goodway learn to ride a horse.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E20 Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save A Swamp Monster / Ultimate Rescue: Pups And The Hidden Golden Bones Cap'n Turbot and Francois lead Mayor Goodway, Julia, and Julius on a swamp tour, until they spot a catfish in trouble. The pups investigate loud noises coming from underneath Adventure Bay.

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E6 Partly Claudia / Ranita's Magic Stripes Dora and Boots take Claudia, a rain cloud, to rain on a dry water slide. / Boots gets a case of Tickle Tail that Ranita the Frog can cure if she gets her magic stripes by helping friends.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E11 The Power Swap / Shore Square After Vigo zaps Fishy Force with his Power Stealing Ray, everyfishy's superpowers get swapped! / Penny Piranha makes up new rules so she never loses at shore shore.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E8 Knighty Knights Blaze must recover a stolen charging machine before everyone in the knight-trucks kingdom runs out of energy and falls asleep, while Crusher tries to become a king by stealing a crown from its owners.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E9 Animal Island Blaze and Stripes discover Animal Island - where everyone is a talking monster truck animal. But a greedy lizard puts the island in peril, so Blaze and Stripes must try to save their new friends.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S8 E22 Pups Save the Kitties and the Kiddies / Pups Save the Greenhouse Mayor Humdinger babysits his new friend's children, but trouble arises when they start feuding with his kitties.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S8 E23 Pups Save The Floating Goodways/pups Save The Portable Pet Wash The Goodways drift out to sea on a swan shaped float and need rescued from a flock of real swans. // Mayor Humdinger steals Katie's Portable Pet Wash and ends up causing bubble trouble all over town.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tim Rex in Space
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E4 Astropumpkin / Spooky Night / Dinerstore Tim and Tommy try to grow the biggest Moon Pumpkin they can. / It's Spooky night, but Tia is scared of the dark. / Tim and Tommy help out at the DinerStore.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E13 The Crew Builds A Mega Stunt Ramp / The Crew Builds A Giant Solar Farm Rubble & Crew use their giant trucks to make awesome stunt ramps when Mega Meister challenges Mayor Greatway to a stunt competition. Power problems shut down Sierra Sparkle's show.

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E12 Construction Psyched! Goby needs help from the Bubble Guppies to retrace his steps and find his lost toy dump truck at a construction site before a wild, bucking bulldozer crushes it!

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E14 Bubble-Cadabra! Abracadabra! The Bubble Guppies discover magic when they stand in for a missing magician and attempt the world's greatest trick - making an elephant disappear!

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E4 Paper Cup Popper Gabby unboxes a Paper Cup Popper that provides an endless supply of paper cups. The Gabby Cats find creative ways to use the cups.

10shakeperth.au.title: Mr. Crocodile
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E3 Buzzy Croc / Dream House Mr. Crocodile worries about his old and new best friends. Daisy and Mr. Crocodile's treehouse gets busy when they add space for all their friends.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E11 Number 5 Through the fun teaching of the Learning Tree and it's Gardener Tim, the curious students Monte and Col, learn about the number five while they exercise together.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E8 The Gold Medal Games It's time for the Gold Medal Games, Blaze is ready to compete! But when Crusher cheats and sends his rival flying far away, Blaze has to speed back to Axle City to beat the buzzer and win that medal!

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E9 The Great Space Race Blaze and AJ take off into space for a race that's out of this world! Along the way to Planet Victory, they meet friendly aliens, dodge asteroids, and face off against Crusher's space ship!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E21 Pups Save A Cuckoo Clock / Pups Save MS. Marjorie's House Chickaletta is stuck inside Jake's family cuckoo clock and it's sliding down the moutnainside! / Mysterious holes are appearing all over Ms. Marjorie's yard, and now she and Maynard have gotten stuck in them!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E22 Pups Rescue Thanksgiving / Pups Save A Windy Bay An inflatable turkey for Adventure Bay's Thanksgiving feast flies away. Zuma competes in Adventure Bay's windsurfing race with Mayor Goodway, Katie, Daring Danny X, and Mayor Humdinger.

10shakeperth.au.title: Super Duper Bunny League
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E1 Lizard Lips! / Space Pirates! The team fights Lizard Lips/ A Space Pirate almost ruins Derek's birthday.

10shakeperth.au.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E4 In Search Of Camp Noodist/kitchen Sponge SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick hike through the woods in search of a fabled nudist colony. // SpongeBob helps Plankton at the Krusty Kanteen, leading to the development of a very familiar sandwich.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Patrick Star Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E11 Face/off-Model / 5 Star Restaurant Squidina helps Patrick get back on-model. // The Star family takes over the Krusty Krab.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Smurfs
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E25 Leaf's Under The Weather / House Call When Leaf gets sick, the weather in the Smurf Village starts to go wild. // The Smurfs find a note from Gargamel begging for his mother because he's sick, so they feel obliged to help him.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Loud House
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E8 Time Trap! When the kids break Mom and Dad's priceless vase, they decide the only thing to do is go back in time to their wedding day and prevent them from ever receiving it.
